jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years. Relationships, lunches, luck, and a clip report at the end of the month.

Interdependence is rebuilding it from the ground up. Interviewed, our proprietary platform, analyzes 300,000+ stories every day across a network of 250,000 journalists. We turn earned media into something measurable, repeatable, and worth paying for — and apply the same data and discipline across paid, social, content, and brand. Integrated marketing run by one team, on one system, accountable to one result.

Forbes named us one of America's Best PR Agencies. Our 100+ person team works with brands, CMOs, founders, and entrepreneurs across consumer, healthcare, tech, B2B, travel and entertainment.

We move fast. The best argument wins. We hire for sharp thinking, real craft, and ownership from day one. If you want comfortable, this isn't the place. If you want to win, build with us.

THE ROLE

We are seeking an accomplished and strategic leader to join the team as a Vice President, Health & Lifestyle. This role requires a seasoned professional with deep expertise in the healthcare industries, outstanding communication skills, and a proven track record in client management and team leadership. As the Vice President, you will spearhead PR initiatives for our clients, lead thought leadership, drive business growth, and deliver impactful results that enhance their reputation and visibility in the market.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leadership: Provide visionary leadership and strategic direction for the health and lifestyle industries, guiding team members to achieve excellence and drive results.
  • Client Management: Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with healthcare clients, serving as the primary point of contact and ensuring delivery of high-quality PR services.
  • Strategy Development: Develop comprehensive PR strategies tailored to each client's objectives and target audience, leveraging industry knowledge and market insights.
  • Campaign Execution: Oversee the implementation of PR campaigns, including media relations, thought leadership initiatives, crisis communications, and executive visibility programs.
  • Team Management: Lead, mentor, and empower a team of PR professionals specializing in health and lifestyle services, fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment.
  • Media Relations: Build and maintain relationships with key health and lifestyle contacts, securing impactful placements in top-tier outlets and healthcare publications.
  • Thought Leadership: Position clients as industry thought leaders through strategic content development, speaking opportunities, and participation in relevant industry events and conferences.
  • Crisis Communications: Develop and implement crisis communication plans to safeguard clients' reputation and mitigate reputational risks in the event of crises or negative publicity.
  • Performance Analysis: Monitor and analyze campaign performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations for optimization and continuous improvement.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN IN YEAR ONE

  • Own the practice's account management rhythm with structured weekly business reviews, account health scoring, and proactive risk identification across the existing client book
  • Bring practice-level retention into the top quartile of the firm through tight service delivery, fast time-to-value on new accounts, and structured save-the-account interventions where necessary
  • Develop and execute 5+ recurring expansion plays within the existing client base, building toward 1.5–2% monthly MRR expansion as a sustained rate
  • Lead and develop the existing healthcare team, direct senior coaching, selective recruiting, and accountability for delivery quality
  • Build a productized healthcare service offering that leverages the Interviewed platform: competitive intelligence, regulatory media monitoring, KOL targeting, payer narrative tracking
  • Win new healthcare clients in partnership with our new business team, with focus on biotech, pharma, medical devices, hospital and health systems, digital health, and consumer wellness
  • Represent the practice externally, industry events, healthcare-specific publications, thought leadership in the healthcare communications space

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in public relations, with a focus on the healthcare and lifestyle industries.
  • Proven track record of successfully managing PR campaigns for healthcare clients, with measurable results in media placements and client satisfaction.
  • Strong leadership and management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team to achieve excellence.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to craft compelling narratives and communicate complex healthcare and lifestyle concepts effectively.
  • Strategic thinker with a deep understanding of the healthcare industry.
  • Extensive network of media contacts and industry connections within the healthcare and lifestyle sectors
  • Results-oriented with a passion for delivering high-quality work and exceeding client expectations.

WHO YOU ARE

  • 15+ years in healthcare communications or healthcare PR, with senior leadership experience leading teams and owning practice-level outcomes
  • Demonstrated specialty depth in at least three of: FDA and regulatory communications, biotech and pharma, medical devices, hospital and health systems, payer relations, clinical trial communications, digital health, healthcare policy
  • A documented track record of measurable client retention and expansion you can describe in numbers
  • Comfortable carrying gross revenue retention, net revenue retention, and expansion as primary KPIs, not just media impressions and placements
  • Strong network of healthcare media contacts across business, trade, clinical, and consumer publications
  • Strategic operator, equally fluent in client strategy, team development, and operational rigor
  • Comfortable with AI-driven workflows and a data-disciplined approach to earned media

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT INTERDEPENDENCE

🏡 100% Remote, Forever - Work from anywhere in the U.S. while enjoying the flexibility of a fully remote workplace. Skip the commute, create a workspace that works for you, and collaborate with teammates across the country, all without sacrificing connection or career growth.

🩺 Comprehensive Health Benefits - Choose from three Anthem Blue Cross PPO medical plans, plus dental and vision coverage to support your health and well-being.

💰 Retirement Savings - Save for the future with our 401(k) program, including a company match that is increasing to 3% by 2027.

🌴 Work-Life Balance - Enjoy paid vacation, sick time, 11 company holidays, a floating holiday, and Summer Fridays to recharge and spend more time doing what you love.

👶 Paid Maternity Leave - We support growing families with paid maternity leave, giving new moms dedicated time to recover, bond with their baby, and return to work with confidence.

📈 Career Growth - As one of the nation's fastest-growing PR and strategic communications firms, we're committed to helping ambitious people grow. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, lead from every level, and build a career with real impact.

🌟 Supportive, Collaborative Culture - We set high standards, celebrate big wins, and work together to achieve exceptional results. You'll join a team that's collaborative, entrepreneurial, and committed to helping one another succeed.

HOW TO APPLY

Submit your resume, a brief cover letter, and one additional document we genuinely want to read: a one-page write-up of your most significant healthcare client retention or expansion outcome. Tell us what the situation was, what you did, and the numbers you moved. The write-up will be weighted more heavily than the resume.

jobs.description:
About Cardiac Care Alliance (CCA)

Cardiac Care Alliance is a Management Services Organization (MSO) dedicated to building a high-performance cardiovascular network. We work in close partnership with independent cardiologists to complement fee-for-service care with value-based care (VBC) models. Our mission is to improve patient access, outcomes, and experiences by delivering proactive, patient-centered care across the cardiac continuum.

Position Summary

CCA is seeking experienced Registered Nurse (RN) Care Managers to support a high-acuity population of patients with complex cardiac conditions, including congestive heart failure (CHF) and other comorbidities. This is a full-time, remote, hourly contract position focused on delivering advanced clinical support through clinical triage, care plan development, and high-risk care management, including Transitional Care Management (TCM), Principal Care Management (PCM), Complex Care Management (CCM), Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), and other applicable clinical programs.

This role is integral to our population health initiatives — proactively supporting at-risk patients with data-informed outreach, continuity of care, and patient-centered engagement. You'll help reduce avoidable hospitalizations, support patient self-management, and contribute to better long-term cardiac outcomes.

This position also serves as the clinical escalation point for non-RN Care Coordinators, supporting continuity and collaboration across the care team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform comprehensive clinical assessments via phone
  • Develop and update individualized care plans for cardiac patients
  • Conduct clinical triage and determine escalation needs
  • Lead TCM efforts post-discharge, including medication reconciliation
  • Provide patient and caregiver education
  • Coordinate with providers and community resources
  • Serve as the initial point of contact for escalations and provide clinical oversight to Care Coordinators
  • Document all patient encounters in accordance with CMS requirements
  • Assess home safety and social determinants of health (SDOH) barriers; escalate resource needs where appropriate
  • Maintain proactive communication with Cardiologists, PCP offices, and other clinical partners
  • Review and act on population health dashboards to address care gaps (annual wellness visits, missing labs, symptom monitoring, etc.)

Clinical Escalation Responsibilities

  • Review reports of CHF symptom worsening
  • Triage symptoms such as chest pain or irregular heartbeat
  • Assess medication side effects
  • Determine need for urgent care or ED visit
  • Assist with advanced care planning or palliative care/hospice guidance
  • Coordinate urgent appointments with cardiology partners

Scope of Practice and Limitations

This role includes clinical assessment, nursing triage, patient education, and care coordination in line with industry standards for RN-led care management. RN Care Managers are expected to:

  • Conduct comprehensive assessments and reassessments to identify high-risk patients
  • Develop and implement patient-centered, evidence-based care plans
  • Perform medication reconciliation and monitor adherence
  • Identify and address gaps in care
  • Facilitate communication across the care team
  • Document clinical findings and interventions per CMS and organizational guidelines
  • Participate in interdisciplinary case conferences and quality improvement initiatives

This role does NOT include:

  • Prescribing medications (non-APRN role)
  • Diagnosing new medical conditions
  • Independent billing or claims processing
  • In-person patient visits
  • Initiating or modifying treatment plans outside of established protocols or without provider input

Qualifications

Required:

  • Active RN license in Texas or a compact state
  • 2+ years of cardiac care or care management experience
  • Knowledge of chronic conditions, especially heart failure and associated comorbidities
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills

Preferred:

  • Based in the Dallas/Fort Worth area
  • Experience with EHRs and Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)
  • Bilingual (Spanish/English)

Position Details

  • Employment Type: Full-Time, W-2 Contract
  • Schedule: 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday
  • Compensation: $45–$60/hour (based on experience)
  • Work Environment: 100% Remote (Dallas/Fort Worth area preferred)
  • Potential for ongoing engagement or full-time employment for the right candidate
  • Must have a dedicated, private workspace suitable for handling PHI, a secure internet connection, and comply with HIPAA and patient privacy policies at all times

micro1 is engaging Mechanical Engineering Technicians to contribute to a customer's project involving the development of advanced AI benchmarks.   2. Source, synthesize, and construct technical datasets (such as test logs, calibration records, sensor outputs, and failure reports) derived from actual lab or production scenarios.
  3. Define accurate solution pathways, including the interpretation of test data and informed next-step recommendations.
  4. Develop rigorous, 35+ item grading rubrics to evaluate technical skills in instrumentation logic, data interpretation, and failure analysis, usable by AI and domain experts alike.

  3. Extensive experience with instrumentation, sensors, data acquisition systems, and prototype testing workflows.
  4. Demonstrated ability to perform in-depth technical documentation of test procedures, outcomes, and failure modes.
  5. Strong analytical skills for interpreting complex datasets and diagnosing equipment or process failures.
  6. Familiarity with technical documentation formats, such as CSVs, spreadsheets, PDFs, and other relevant files.

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

jobs.excerpt: GHX is seeking a strategic, systems-oriented Product Commercialization Manager to own and elevate the end-to-end commercialization process across our portfolio, including pricing, SKUs, process and tool management.
jobs.description:
GHX is seeking a strategic, systems-oriented Product Commercialization Manager to own and elevate the end-to-end commercialization process across our portfolio, including pricing, SKUs, process and tool management. The role serves as the connective tissue between commercial strategy and operational execution — driving efficiency, scalability, and data integrity across the entire product commercialization lifecycle.

The right candidate brings both operational rigor and transformational vision — someone who can rationalize a complex SKU library, redesign product commercialization operating system using AI-powered automation, and build governance frameworks that enable faster, more precise market entry.Someone who is enthusiastic about managing projects but also willing to roll up their sleeves and do the work. A personable, determined individual who enjoys leading and facilitating cross-functional collaborations will thrive in this role.

Responsibilities:

Commercialization Process Ownership

  • Own the end-to-end commercialization process — from product definition through SKU creation to Launch— in partnership with Product Management, Corporate Systems, Deals Desk, Contract Ops, Order Processing, Revenue Recognition, and Asset Management.
  • Establish and continuously improve SOPs, tooling configurations, and business rules that reduce cycle time, eliminate ambiguity, and scale across GHX's expanding portfolio; maintain the commercialization playbook as the single source of truth for pricing, SKUs, and business rules.
  • Partner with Product Management to translate new offerings into sellable, billable constructs aligned to commercial strategy; serve as cross-functional liaison for complex SKUs and pricing decisions requiring commercial judgment.
  • Define, monitor, and report on SLAs, KPIs, and quality metrics for commercialization activities, delivering executive-ready insights on a regular cadence.
  • Stay current on AI and ML capabilities in CPQ; proactively surface forward-looking recommendations to leadership and cross-functional partners.

SKU Management & Catalog Governance

  • Own the full SKU lifecycle in CPQ (currently Conga) — including creation, testing, release, modification, and deprecation.
  • Lead a structured cross-functional SKU audit; rationalize the catalog and present findings and recommendations to leadership; establish ongoing governance including intake/approval workflows, naming conventions, taxonomy standards, and hygiene reviews.
  • Partner with Product, Finance, and Sales to ensure every SKU maps to a clear commercial purpose, pricing strategy, contractual language, and business rules; develop a change management process that minimizes disruption to active quotes, in-flight contracts, and renewal cycles.
  • Own the AI and automation innovation roadmap for SKU and commercialization processes — identifying high-value opportunities and driving measurable reduction in manual processing time.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy

  • Serve as the connective tissue between Product Management and all partner functions, including Sales, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, Contract Operations, FP&A, Corporate Systems, and Revenue Enablement — aligning teams on process, tooling, and commercialization standards.
  • Contribute to pricing strategy and monetization model design; champion data-driven decision-making through dashboards and reporting frameworks that give leadership visibility into commercialization health.
  • Coordinate launch readiness for new products and pricing changes, ensuring Sales, Deal Desk, and Contract Operations are prepared before market release; act as a trusted advisor and go-to resource for commercialization process questions.

Key Competencies:

  • Translates business objectives into commercialization strategies; anticipates downstream impacts of process, pricing, and catalog decisions on revenue recognition, margin, and customer lifetime value.
  • Understands SaaS business models, subscription economics, and ARR/MRR dynamics; connects P&L awareness and process efficiency to growth acceleration.
  • Designs scalable, end-to-end commercialization processes with an automation-first, exception-second bias — comfortable operating from architecture-level design down to hands-on configuration and SOP documentation.
  • Uses quantitative analysis and operational data to identify problems, size opportunities, and evaluate trade-offs; designs reporting frameworks and dashboards that give leadership actionable visibility into commercialization health.
  • Sets clear goals, tracks progress rigorously, and communicates status proactively to executive, commercial, and technical audiences alike.
  • Builds trust across Product, Sales, Finance, Legal, and Technology without direct authority; navigates competing priorities with diplomacy and persistence.
  • Anticipates resistance to change and designs enablement strategies that drive adoption; delivers results with speed and quality in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Actively explores and applies AI and automation to commercialization challenges; evaluates tools critically with attention to limitations, compliance implications, and auditability.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Operations, Information Systems, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in product operations, revenue operations, deal desk, commercial program management, or a closely related function within a B2B SaaS company.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Salesforce Conga (Apttus) — including product catalog management, pricing rules, approval workflows, and SKU configuration.
  • Proven track record leading cross-functional process improvement or transformation initiatives with measurable business outcomes (e.g., cycle time reduction, error rate improvement, revenue acceleration)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce executive-ready documentation, SOPs, and business cases.

  • Project management discipline: ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, prioritize effectively under pressure, and deliver against commitments.

  • Willingness to travel quarterly for team meetings (approximately 10-20%).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with AI and automation concepts as they apply to commercial operations, quoting, or contract workflows.
  • Experience conducting SKU, product catalog, or similar rationalization audits in complex, multi-product environments.
  • Prior involvement in a quote-to-cash re-platforming or major system migration.
  • Proficiency with BI and analytics tools such as Sigma or Power BI for building commercialization performance dashboards.
  • Any of the following certifications:
    • Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist or Salesforce Certified Administrator
    • Conga CPQ Product Administration Certification (Level 1 or Level 2)
    • PMP, Agile/Scrum, or SAFe® Product Owner / Product Manager certification

Estimated salary range: $91,000 - $121,000

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the GHX’s salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and proficiency for the role. jobs.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

We're hiring a Senior Retail Operations Specialist to run the daily engine behind Grüns retail fulfillment. You'll ensure every order ships accurately, on time, and in full - protecting revenue, keeping retail partners happy, and catching problems before they become costly. This role connects internal ops, 3PLs, and retail accounts, and owns the proactive inventory and OTIF work that keeps our retail business scaling cleanly. This role reports to our Director of Retail Operations.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Own day-to-day retail order fulfillment, monitoring and resolving "where's my product" issues before they turn into late or incomplete shipments.
  • Proactively manage base inventory to get ahead of shortages - flagging risk before orders are shorted, not after.
  • Process new orders accurately and on schedule to keep product flowing without disruption.
  • Run proactive inventory reviews for promotions and new item launches to ensure plans execute cleanly.
  • Track OTIF performance, chargebacks, and late trucks, and drive the process improvements that move those numbers.
  • Manage 3PL and logistics partner relationships, resolving escalations and holding partners to SLA.
  • Build and document SOPs across retail ops - receiving, lot/expiry management, promotions, and returns - so the function scales with the business.
  • Identify tools (including AI) and workflow changes that make the role and the broader retail ops function more efficient.

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 3+ years of experience in retail operations, order fulfillment, or replenishment in a CPG environment, with a genuinely analytical approach to the work.
  • Has direct experience with Walmart and Club channel (Sam's Club, Costco), and ideally distributors like UNFI or KeHE.
  • Understands EDI order management, lot codes, and expiration handling in a retail fulfillment context.
  • Is fluent in Excel or Google Sheets - pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, basic modeling - and comfortable with ERP/WMS systems (Fulfil.io a strong plus).
  • Communicates clearly and confidently with both internal teams and external retail/logistics partners.
  • Is comfortable using AI tools like Claude to move faster and think more clearly, not just check a box.
  • Has a track record of finding and fixing inefficiency, not just maintaining what exists.

Approach to the role:

  • Proactive - flags problems before they become fires, not after.
  • Organized under pressure - manages competing priorities without dropping the important ones.
  • Independent - doesn't need to be managed to stay ahead of the work.
  • Data-driven - makes the call based on facts, not assumptions.
  • Curious and iterative - always looking for a cleaner, faster way to do it.

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $90,000 - $100,000 plus bonus depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

Technical Support Analyst

Remote-United States

Monday to Friday from 9 to 6 EST, 8-5 CST, and 7 to 4 MST

The Technical Support Analyst (TSA) is a developmental level position within the Support organization primarily responsible for working with CSC Corptax® customers to help with inquiries related to the server and workstation installation and maintenance of Corptax products. The TSA develops a high-level knowledge of the Corptax products and couples that with technical knowledge of Microsoft enterprise systems and related information technologies to validate customer installations and triage customer questions.

The TSA’s primary role is to respond to all customer inquiries regardless of the inbound support channel: online case, phone, email, chat, etc. for questions of a technical nature. This role will occasionally require overtime, including weekends based on customer filing trends/needs. A rotating on-call will be required. Travel is not typically required for this position.

Some of the things you will be doing:

  • Provide technical case support (all channels) for all Corptax customers and other internal Corptax teams using the then-current tools available to the Support organization.
  • Understand customer needs and provide personalized support to assigned customers or other customers as requested based on areas of specialization/expertise and customer need.
  • Respond to and provide appropriate solutions to intermediate level customer inquiries while maintaining moderate case closure rates.
  • Collaborate with team members in a fast-paced environment.
  • Work under clearly defined guidelines, with moderate supervision, making sound decisions based on previous experience and confirming your conclusions with more senior level team members prior to execution.

About the Role

Payroll isn't just numbers on a spreadsheet. It's the promise the company keeps to every employee, every pay cycle, no matter which state or territory they call home. As our Payroll Analyst, you'll be the technical and regulatory authority who makes sure that promise never breaks. You'll own end-to-end payroll settlement execution and tax compliance for a fully remote, all-states-and-territories workforce, and you'll be the connective tissue between Payroll and Accounting, making sure Finance leadership always has clear, trustworthy payroll reporting to work from.

This role is built on a clean separation of duties: you execute with precision after approval, and you guard compliance independently. That combination of executor and compliance guardian is what keeps our financial integrity and audit readiness rock solid.

What You'll Do

Settlement Execution 

  • Execute payroll settlement following the Senior Manager, Accounting's approval: bank upload, 401(k)/HSA remittances, post-payroll sign-off 
  • Process cancel/correct actions only under documented authorization from the Senior Manager, Accounting 
  • Prepare settlement summary reports for Finance leadership 

Tax Compliance 

  • Upload tax notifications to the HRIS as received to maintain compliance across state and local tax jurisdictions 
  • Analyze payroll tax variances and reconciliation items; escalate anomalies to the Senior Manager, Accounting 

Cross-Functional 

  • Serve as Finance's subject-matter expert on payroll tax and settlement questions from CX Partners and external auditors 
  • Maintain documentation supporting quarterly/annual compliance and settlement audits 
  • Provide technical guidance on payroll tax implications of new-state hiring, benefits changes, or comp structure updates 

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; payroll certification (CPP or similar) strongly preferred 
  • 3–5+ years of experience in payroll settlement, payroll tax compliance, or multi-state payroll administration 
  • Deep knowledge of federal, state, and local payroll tax law for a remote, all-states/territories workforce 
  • Experience configuring tax and settlement modules within an HRIS platform (Paycom, Workday, ADP, UKG, or similar) 
  • Strong analytical and research skills to track and interpret evolving tax regulations 
  • Able to translate payroll and compliance details into clear, accessible updates for non-payroll audiences, including Finance leadership
  • High level of integrity and independence — this role executes settlement but does not approve its own work 

Why Join Us

At Nightingale, precision work like this ripples outward. Getting payroll right, on time, every time, is how we take care of the employees who take care of our students. Alpha Online entwickelt die Prozessmanagement-Software für den professionellen Gebrauchtwagenhandel in Deutschland. Seit 2024 sind wir Teil von CarOnSale, dem KI-gestützten Betriebssystem für den B2B-Gebrauchtwagenhandel in Europa.

One Platform. One Profit Engine.

  • Du betreust einen festen Kundenstamm aus Autohäusern und Autohausgruppen und bist ihre erste Ansprechperson für alles rund um den AlphaController

  • Du erkennst, wo Kunden das Produkt noch nicht ausschöpfen, und machst konkrete Vorschläge
  • Du steuerst Anforderungen und Fehlermeldungen aus dem Kundenkontakt als Tickets in Jira an die Entwicklung

Du startest mit einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase direkt bei der Geschäftsführung und lernst Produkt, Kunden und Markt von innen kennen. Danach entscheiden wir gemeinsam, ob dein Schwerpunkt im Customer Success oder im Kunden-Onboarding liegt.

Was du mitbringst

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau in Wort und Schrift
  • Interesse an komplexen Softwareprodukten und die Bereitschaft, dich tief einzuarbeiten

Von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung aus dem Automobilhandel oder dem Autohaus-Alltag
  • KI-affine Arbeitsweise: du nutzt Tools wie Claude, ChatGPT oder Copilot aktiv im Arbeitsalltag

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung mit attraktiver Vergütung
  • Nahezu 100 % Remote – Wohnsitz in Deutschland erforderlich

  • Ein Umfeld, in dem KI und Digitalisierung echte Rolle spielen – kein Lippenbekenntnis

The Senior Principal Consultant serves as senior technical expert on project tasks to ensure quality services are delivered on schedule and within available budget to meet customer requirements. This includes providing technical expertise to the project manager and project team members with initiating, planning, executing, monitoring, and controlling and closing projects. As part of a project team, the Senior Principal Consultant will maintain relationships with clients and key decision makers to help identify new business opportunities.

What You Will Do:

  • Serve as senior technical expert on project tasks to ensure quality services are delivered on schedule and within available budget to meet customer requirements.

o Provide frequent updates to the project manager.

o Assist project manager with defining and sequencing project tasks, estimating task duration and developing a project schedule as part of developing a project plan.

o Review project plans to understand the scope, schedule and assigned work.

o Participate in client and project team meetings.

o Assist with research and data analysis, including assisting with conducting customer or stakeholder analyses.

o Prepare written documents, reports, and presentations, and assist with giving presentations to clients.

o Track and accurately report hours spent on projects.

o Work with individuals at all levels, provide input to reports and other deliverables, execute multiple assignments, meet agreed deadlines, and adjust to changing client demands.

o Perform quality assurance on project deliverables.

  • Engage frequently for input related to area of expertise to provides valuable insight that helps enhance the business.
  • Demonstrate a firm understanding of business and implement opportunities for enhancing effectiveness and efficiencies across the organization.
  • Develop relationships with existing customers to facilitate development of new business opportunities for current and/or additional services.

o Understand and be conversant in ABS Group products and services.

o Meet with new and existing clients and actively listen to their needs.

o Communicate client needs to project managers.

o Review published reports and news articles about existing and potential new clients to identify customer intelligence.

o Participate in proposal development.

  • Represent ABS Group and participate in promoting our products and services

o Participate in marketing activities, conference presentations, technical whitepapers.

o Networking to meet new potential clients.

  • ICS/OT Cybersecurity Focus

o Support ICS/OT cybersecurity activities within capital projects, operational programs, and compliance-related initiatives in industrial environments.

o Serve as a cybersecurity advisor to control systems and project teams, helping align security, operational, and client requirements.

o Coordinate with cybersecurity, control systems, IT, operations, and other stakeholders to support project execution and client outcomes.

o Contribute to cybersecurity-related documentation, compliance support activities, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.

o Support identification of client needs and service opportunities related to industrial cybersecurity, control systems, and operational resilience.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • 15+ years of relevant professional experience
  • Must have an advanced degree or bachelor’s degree and equivalent experience
  • Professional certifications required
  • US Citizenship required for roles supporting government contracts

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to gain, retain, illustrate comprehension of learned technical knowledge, and transfer knowledge to other members of the team
  • Ability to mentor/coach mid-level consultants and hone technical skills in others
  • Ability to actively listen to the needs of our clients by receiving shared information and determine context of the information provided and generating probing questions to better understand, retaining the information for future access, engaging with sales team on potential opportunities, suggesting solutions to sales team, and responding with proposed solutions
  • Openly accepts change as part of business evolution to meet the needs of our clients, provides recommendations to enhance business, and drives change across the organization.
  • Possess a firm understanding of key performance indicators and their significance to the business and take action to drive results amongst the organization.
  • Ability to utilize established rapport and role as a subject matter expert with existing clients to facilitate development of new business through identifying and consistently generating new business opportunities
  • Ability to coach others on development of customer intimacy and new opportunities
  • Demonstrated ability to plan and deliver successful outcomes
  • Must take responsibility for their actions, behaviors, decisions, and results and those of the team they lead
  • Must seek feedback and utilize root cause analysis to improve performance
  • Must understand business goals and hold self and team members accountable for keeping commitments and high standards
  • Must be dependable, highly reliable and follow through on all assignments
  • Ability to demonstrate independent, objective, open-minded thinking with strong attention to detail and sound judgment.
  • Demonstrate a proficient level of time management skills
  • Working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management System.
  • While the position is remote, regular travel (50%+) to client sites and project locations is a core part of the role.

$150k - $190k

Reports to a director or executive level position. May have individual contributor and/or managing direct reports.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Remote Operations and Administrative Coordinator to support and coordinate daily transportation operations. This role will oversee driver recruitment, scheduling, route coordination, attendance and performance tracking, customer and parent communications, and operational follow-up. The position will also support payroll, invoicing, collections, data entry, vehicle maintenance coordination, and daily administrative tasks. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with QuickBooks, Asana, Monday.com, CRM, tracking, scheduling, and other business software, while managing multiple priorities and ensuring daily operations run efficiently. The successful candidate will be a dependable, detail-oriented, and resourceful professional with strong communication and problem-solving skills.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Recruit, onboard, and manage drivers.
  • Schedule and coordinate driver routes, including afternoon and evening runs.
  • Monitor driver attendance, punctuality, route progress, and phone usage.
  • Manage driver tracking and camera-monitoring systems, including phone-use alerts.
  • Handle calls and inquiries from parents, customers, and drivers.
  • Coordinate driver updates, schedule changes, replacements, and operational communications.
  • Follow up with mechanics on vehicle repairs and maintenance.
  • Enter and maintain driver, customer, address, and route information in company software.
  • Prepare and process payroll accurately and on time.
  • Prepare invoices and manage collections and payment follow-ups.
  • Resolve customer and parent concerns related to transportation services.
  • Maintain accurate operational records and ensure daily transportation activities run smoothly.
  • Perform other duties related to the position as assigned.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Proficient level of English (written and spoken).
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and email correspondence skills.
  • Experience in Administrative Support, Operations, or Customer Service-related roles.
  • Experience using Asana, Monday.com, or similar project management platforms.
  • Familiarity with CRM, tracking, scheduling, or similar business software.
  • Familiarity with QuickBooks for basic financial and administrative functions – preferred.
  • Experience with payroll, invoicing, collections, and/or administrative tasks – preferred.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and follow established processes.
  • Quick learner with the ability to adapt to new systems and workflows.
  • Professional, dependable, coachable, and accountable with excellent attendance.
  • Creative, resourceful, and proactive with an out-of-the-box mindset.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), and standard business tools (email, spreadsheets, document management).
  • Availability to work 6:30 AM - 2:30 PM Eastern Time (New York).
  • Interested in long-term career opportunities.
  • Reliable computer (Windows 10 or newer), two monitors, and stable high-speed internet.﻿
  • Professional home workstation capable of supporting uninterrupted remote work.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • 100% remote work.
  • Compensation in USD.
  • Full-time position with 40 hours weekly.
  • Please note that this is a long-term opportunity.
  • Great work environment with potential for growth.

jobs.excerpt: • Location: Remote — U. S. -based required.  For this opening we give preference to candidates based in the Central or Mountain time zones; all zones are considered if the coverage window below genuinely works for your life.
jobs.description:
• Location: Remote — U.S.-based required. For this opening we give preference to candidates based in the Central or Mountain time zones; all zones are considered if the coverage window below genuinely works for your life.

  • Reports to: Head of Sales

About Breathe for Change

Breathe for Change (B4C) is building the category of Human Intelligence in Education to address the crises of educator stress and burnout, student mental health, and AI disruption. Our accredited higher-education programs — anchored by our Master's of Education — equip educators with the human skills they and their students need most to thrive. We envision a world where school is about what truly matters: empowering students AND teachers to live purposeful, creative lives full of vitality, wholeness, and connection.

The role

You'll be a full-cycle inside sales professional guiding teachers through the decision to enroll in B4C's degree programs. Marketing fills your calendar with booked 1:1 phone calls — you run a consultative discovery conversation, help each educator reach an honest fit decision, and enroll the ones the program genuinely serves.

Know what you'd be selling: a Master's degree our graduates consistently describe as transformative — for their teaching, their wellbeing, and their lives. Every enrollment you close is a teacher who stays in the profession stronger than they came to it. Most sales jobs ask you to believe in the product as a professional courtesy; this one earns it.

Three things to know about how we work, because they tell you whether this seat is for you:

You'd be joining an awesome team

This is a small group of mission-driven professionals who genuinely like each other and are unusually good at what they do. We chase a team goal — the number belongs to all of us, not to a leaderboard of individuals — so the incentive is to make the person next to you better. Reps trade what's working in real time, review each other's calls in the film room, and celebrate each other's wins loudly. If you've worked somewhere the top closer hoarded their tricks and the floor went quiet when someone was behind, this will feel different on day one.

We take selling seriously as a craft

Our motion is documented and built from what our best people actually do, not from theory — most of our wins close on the first substantive conversation, carried by disciplined follow-up. Everything we've built around it — the playbook, the coaching, the AI tooling — exists to get you to full speed fast: weeks, not quarters. After that, the book is yours to run. There are no individual volume quotas and no commission — we make sure you have a strong, steady set of calls, flexing up and down a bit during the highest-demand weeks and months, but overall protecting your calendar against getting overloaded. We hire people who run their own week, and then we get out of the way.

We sell with integrity, structurally

Teachers are trust professionals and our buyers for life — pressure tactics, false urgency, and manufactured scarcity don't just violate our values, they're incompatible with how we're regulated and how we retain students. Honest disqualification is a celebrated outcome. The product is what makes this possible: our graduates rate the program at an NPS in the +70s, so the honest conversation and the effective one are the same conversation. If your best work happens when you're allowed to tell a prospect the truth, you'll like it here.

What you'll actually do

  • Run ~8–12 scheduled discovery calls a day* (20 minutes each) with teachers who booked time to talk about the M.Ed. — assess fit, run real discovery, answer program and financing questions, and ask for the enrollment decision when the signal is there. *Daily volume fluctuates with seasonality, events, and experience.

  • Own the follow-up between calls: short, purposeful texting that protects shows and carries momentum, completion calls that finish decisions, and the follow-through that means nothing you promised a teacher ever slips.

  • Sell when teachers can talk. During the school year our calls concentrate in two windows: teachers' planning/lunch periods (roughly noon–2pm ET) and after school (roughly 4–8pm ET); in summer the weight shifts earlier. Your core coverage window is approximately noon–8pm ET on weekdays — in Central or Mountain time that's an ordinary late-morning-to-early-evening day, which is why we prefer those zones. Our best reps design their week around the teacher's clock on purpose; this role requires that design to be genuine and sustainable, not overtime.

  • Hand each newly enrolled educator cleanly to our onboarding team. Your job is the decision — a dedicated team carries students from deposit to day one, so your selling time stays selling time.

  • Bring what you learn back to the team: film-room participation, script feedback, sharing what's working. Our playbook carries our reps' wording because their wording works.

Who we're looking for

  • A proven consultative closer. 2+ years in a full-cycle closing role — high-consideration B2C (education, financial services, insurance, home services, coaching/wellness programs) or similar consultative sales — with a track record you can quantify and explain how it was measured.

  • One-conversation instincts. You know how to earn a decision in the first call when the fit is real — discovery first, then a direct, unapologetic ask — and how to walk away warmly when it isn't.

  • Follow-through as craft. You can describe the actual system you use to keep 100+ open conversations from slipping. Organized is table stakes; we're looking for someone who treats follow-up as the job, not the interruption.

  • A fast, eager tool adopter. This role runs on systems — a CRM (HubSpot a plus), AI-assisted call review and coaching, texting and scheduling tools, Google Workspace — and the stack keeps getting better. You don't just tolerate new tools; you pick them up quickly, fold them into how you work, and treat them as part of the craft.

  • A calendar owner. You manage your own energy and hours like a professional athlete — boundaries, blocks, evening selling by design, recovery budgeted after surges.

  • A teammate on purpose. Our reps get better in public — film-room reviews, script feedback, lending your wording to the playbook when it works. You want colleagues who sharpen your game and you return the favor; closers who guard their tricks don't thrive here.

  • Mission-resonant. You care that the thing you're selling genuinely changes teachers' lives, and you can say why in your own words. Our best closers are here on purpose — selling work that matters is the point.

You do NOT need admissions, higher-ed, or education-industry experience. We'll teach you the domain, the program, and the playbook — that's what our onboarding and coaching system is for. What we can't teach in eight weeks is professional selling. If you're a great closer who has always wanted your work to mean something, this is the seat.

Growth

This role has a real career ladder: EDC → Senior EDC, with promotion earned on craft, ownership, team impact, and judgment — assessed from your actual work, not tenure. Our most recent Senior promotion went to a rep whose calls became the film-room examples the team learns from. We promote from within on purpose.

Why this seat

Sales careers rarely offer all three: a product with real outcomes, a team of mission-driven professionals who treat selling as a craft worth studying and pull for each other, and a mission you'd defend at dinner. Teachers are holding up the hardest job in America, and the ones who find us are looking for a way to grow without leaving the classroom. You'd be the person who helps them decide well. If you've been waiting for a reason to bring your best selling somewhere it counts, this is it.

Compensation & benefits

  • Base salary: $80,000–$100,000, depending on experience and demonstrated track record

  • Equity eligibility (varies by experience)

  • Health, vision, and dental insurance

  • 401k and FSA/HSA eligibility

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Note: per our accreditation and Title IV compliance posture, compensation is never linked to enrollment counts — raises and promotions are earned on craft and professional factors. (Stated here because good salespeople always ask.)

How to apply

The application asks five short questions — they matter more than your résumé, and we read every answer.

Breathe for Change is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Compensation Range: $80K - $100K

jobs.excerpt: About A1There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

Role

You will support end-to-end recruiting for A1’s product, engineering, and business roles.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. You will work closely with recruiters and hiring managers to keep hiring moving smoothly and accurately. It’s a good fit for someone early in their career who wants to learn how high-quality technical hiring actually works in practice.

What you will be doing

  • Support the full recruitment process across roles, from sourcing and screening to interview coordination and offer support.

  • Source candidates through a mix of channels, including LinkedIn, referrals, job boards, and proactive outreach.

  • Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate screens to assess basic role fit, motivation, and communication.

  • Coordinate interviews, scheduling, and feedback collection with candidates and hiring managers.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate records in the ATS, ensuring data quality and process consistency.

  • Support recruiting projects and process improvements as the team scales, including candidate experience and employer branding initiatives.

  • Help keep hiring operations organised, responsive, and moving at pace.

What you will need

  • 0–2 years of experience in recruiting, HR, operations, coordination, or related roles
    (fresh graduates with a strong interest in recruiting are welcome).

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfort working with tools such as Google Sheets / Excel and basic ATS systems.

  • A proactive, learning-oriented mindset and openness to feedback.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and follow through reliably.

(Prior recruiting experience is helpful but not required. Attitude, curiosity, and execution matter more.)

Why join A1

  • Learn technical recruiting from the ground up in a small, high-bar team.

  • Work closely with experienced recruiters, engineers, and hiring managers.

  • Hands-on ownership and real responsibility from day one.

  • Flat structure where initiative and execution matter more than titles.

  • Clear growth path into Talent Partner, Recruiter, or specialised technical hiring roles.

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful career development.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Data Entry Keyer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Data Entry Keyers to contribute to a customer's advanced AI benchmark project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Design and produce expert-level evaluation tasks that simulate real-world data entry and validation challenges for AI agents.
  2. Construct and curate large, complex datasets—including CSVs, PDFs, spreadsheets, and technical documents filled with realistic errors such as malformed records, missing data, and inconsistent formats.
  3. Define the correct final state for each task, specifying the exact error cases and reconciliation requirements that an AI must address.
  4. Author detailed grading rubrics (35+ criteria) for assessment of AI agent outputs, focusing on both accuracy and completeness in error detection.
  5. Ensure all authored tasks mirror the authentic complexity and standards of highly regulated or audit-sensitive environments.
  6. Collaborate asynchronously through precise written and verbal communication to iterate and refine evaluation materials.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Extensive experience in data entry, quality assurance, or data validation within regulated or audit-sensitive domains such as healthcare claims, finance back office, or legal operations.
  2. Demonstrated ability to achieve and document high accuracy standards, including measurable error rates and outcomes.
  3. Strong skills in detecting and analyzing data inconsistencies, silent truncations, and formatting irregularities across diverse file types.
  4. Proficient written English, enabling clear drafting of complex evaluation tasks and comprehensive grading rubrics.
  5. Exceptional attention to detail and a disciplined, process-oriented work style.
  6. Experience contributing to projects with high stakes for compliance, accuracy, or data integrity is highly valued.
  7. Comfort working independently and communicating proactively within remote, distributed project environments.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

  • 8 years of proven experience managing technical programs.

  • Passion and drive to change consumer finance for the better.

  • Organized and strategic approach to collaborating across multi-disciplinary teams.

  • Obsesses over getting the details right but knows how to ship on time.

  • Working and driving strategic programs and building a remote friendly culture.

  • Actively mentors and levels up team members.

  • Track record of successfully driving complex large technology applications and geographically distributed backend systems.

  • Track record of strong stakeholder management with Engineering, Product, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams.

Pay Grade - N

Equity Grade - 10

Location: Remote

About ImagineArt

We're redefining how the world creates and designs.

ImagineArt is one of the fastest-growing GenAI companies in the world. We've scaled faster than most funded startups — with zero outside funding.

  • $35M+ ARR crossed this year

  • 100M+ social impressions

  • Built and shipped our own image generation model, now ranked #3 globally for photo realism

No funding. No shortcuts. Just a sharp, driven team building one of the strongest GenAI products in the world — and we're just getting started.

If you want to build something that truly matters, work with exceptionally smart people, and grow at a pace most companies never experience, ImagineArt is the place.

Job Summary

ImagineArt is looking for a PR & Influencer Marketing Lead to own our external narrative and creator relationships. You'll drive media coverage, manage influencer campaigns, and position ImagineArt as the defining AI creative platform globally. This is a high-ownership role — you're not executing someone else's PR playbook, you're writing ours. If you have a sharp eye for story, deep roots in creator culture, and the hustle to land meaningful press, we want to talk.

What You'll Do

  • Own PR Strategy End-to-End: Drive pitching, placements, and press relationships across tech, creative, and mainstream media. Identify and execute earned media opportunities in publications like Forbes, TechCrunch, The Verge, and beyond

jobs.description:
About the Team

HubSpot’s Downmarket Product Org is responsible for overseeing our broader portfolio of freemium products - shaping the core product experience and powering every key moment in the customer lifecycle, from the first interaction through long term retention and expansion.

We are scaling our Monetization function within this team. The group will focus on one of the most important and interesting challenges in software today: determining how to help customers discover and purchase your product in the age of AI and Agents, for headless and UI-based use cases, and with credits as an emerging pricing model.

About the Role

The traditional PLG monetization model was built for a world of static, tier-based upgrades accessed through a point-and-click UI. We are moving toward agent-based, credit-priced products distributed across multiple surfaces - including APIs and LLM interfaces - and our buying strategy must evolve to match.

As a Staff Product Manager for Monetization and Product Led Growth, you will own the evolution of this buying experience. This will include two charters:

  • Being the single person who can oversee the entire end-to-end buying journey across various prospect and customer touchpoints
  • Rebuilding our monetization infrastructure from static upgrade prompts in HubSpot’s UI, to agentically delivered, just-in-time, contextual upgrade moments delivered both in-app and via LLM interfaces. We will define and build the capabilities to recommend and sell the right product to the right customer at the right time, agnostic of whether they are using HubSpot in our app or via MCP.

What You Will Do

  • You will own the buying, product discovery, and upgrade experience across HubSpot. You will be the single Product Manager accountable for how customers move from our freemium funnel to the solutions that best meet their needs.
  • You will define HubSpot’s Product Led Monetization strategy for the AI era. This includes evolving from static upgrade triggers to personalized, context aware upgrade moments powered by large language models and delivered through conversational assistants and MCP. You will help define what an upgrade moment looks like and means when users don’t have a traditional UI to interact with and monetization becomes more usage-based.
  • You will partner with product teams across HubSpot to align buying patterns and create a coherent, consistent customer experience across the platform.
  • You will work closely with go to market teams on pricing launches, upgrade campaigns, and customer communication strategies related to driving monetization.
  • You will present strategies, progress, and results to senior leaders, including members of the executive team.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have owned monetization or the buying experience for a software as a service product. This is a core area of expertise for you.
  • You have worked on a product with credit based, usage based, or outcome based pricing. You understand how these models affect both how a product is built and how it is sold.
  • You have driven alignment across multiple product groups without relying on direct authority. You know how to influence decisions, build commitment, and move teams toward a shared outcome.
  • You have meaningful AI product experience. You have worked on or alongside products built around artificial intelligence, and you understand how large language models are changing product strategy, customer expectations, and business models.
  • You bring strong business model fluency. You can think strategically about pricing, packaging, monetization, and go to market motions, not only feature roadmaps.
  • You have worked in both a scaled organization and a more entrepreneurial environment. You can navigate the complexity of a large company while remaining comfortable building something new from the ground up.
  • You are a driver who moves quickly and takes ownership. You are comfortable challenging existing approaches when needed, and you do not wait for perfect information before making progress.

Why This Role Matters

The entire software industry is working to determine how AI products should be priced, packaged, and sold.

HubSpot has more than 250,000 customers, an active credit based monetization system, strong Agents and usage through MCPs. In this role, you will be at the center of translating those strengths into the next generation of Product Led Growth, not as a theoretical exercise, but through products and experiences used by real customers.

This is a Staff level opportunity with meaningful greenfield scope, direct visibility with executive leadership, and the chance to define what Product Led Growth looks like at one of the most recognized brands in software as a service.

In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

Organization Overview:

Trans Lifeline is a nonprofit organization dedicated to providing our trans peers with the connection, care, and advocacy we need and deserve. Founded in 2014, Trans Lifeline operates three core program areas that serve the trans and gender-nonconforming (GNC) community:

  1. Our Hotline program, which operates a confidential peer-support hotline for trans and (GNC) folks, staffed by trans and GNC folks, where we provide emotional support, crisis intervention, and referrals to resources such as healthcare, housing, and legal assistance.

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreImprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

THE ROLE

As Imprint's Senior Engineering Manager for Security, you will report to the Director of Engineering for Trust & Security. You will own the entire security engineering foundation. This includes AI security governance, application security, cloud infrastructure, detection and response, and identity management. You'll build this with AI leverage from day one, scaling a small team's impact with modern tooling.

Imprint is deliberately small and talent-dense. We use AI and tooling to give every person outsized leverage. This is a role where you can stay hands-on for as long as it makes sense. You set the strategic direction and do the work. Whether that balance shifts over time depends on what the business needs and what you want to build.

We power co-branded credit card programs for 10+ enterprise partners, with AI embedded across the business: underwriting, servicing, and how we build software. That AI leverage is core to how Imprint operates, and it creates a security challenge worth solving: how do you build an AI-forward security posture for an organization that moves this fast?

WHY THIS ROLE IS SPECIAL

  • Stay Hands-On: Write detection rules, review PRs, file hardening commits, and threat-model features alongside engineering teams. If you've been pushed into pure management and miss building, this role gives you permission to get back to it while still setting strategic direction.

  • AI-Native Security: Build security capabilities using AI agents for detection triage, compliance automation, and dependency management. You'll secure AI products and use AI to multiply your own leverage. This is how a small team operates at the standards of a company 10x its size.

  • Full-Stack Ownership: Own the entire security domain: application security, cloud infrastructure, detection engineering, and AI governance.

  • Preventative, Not Reactive: Build security that scales with the business rather than firefighting inherited problems. Do it right from the start, before bad patterns harden.

  • Series D Sweet Spot: We have product-market fit and real traction, but we're still small enough for you to shape everything. Your decisions will drive our security posture for years to come.

  • High-Trust Domain: Co-branded credit cards in regulated fintech (PCI, SOC 2, ISO). Security isn't a tax here; it's what enables every partner launch and every customer interaction.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • AI security: threat-model Imprint's agent surfaces for prompt injection, tool misuse, and authorization boundaries.

  • AI for security: build AI-native capabilities that scale a small team's impact: AI-powered detection triage, automated compliance evidence collection, and threat-modeling assistance.

  • Application security: threat modeling for new features, secure code review, SAST/SCA/DAST in CI, SDL design, dependency management, and secrets management. You read Go and TypeScript well enough to review PRs and catch the bugs that external audits should not have to find.

  • Cloud and infrastructure security: IAM partitioning across multiple AWS accounts, least-privilege access, JIT elevation, cross-account trust hardening, KMS boundaries, SCP design, Kubernetes pod security, egress filtering, and Terraform security review.

  • Detection and response: build the SIEM/SOAR pipeline from log sources through triage, write correlation rules, enable AI-powered triage, stand up on-call rotation, and create incident response runbooks.

  • Identity and access: drive SSO coverage, access reviews, and JIT elevation in partnership with IT.

  • Compliance partnership: design and implement the controls that satisfy SOC 2, PCI, and ISO evidence requirements. GRC runs the audit cycle. You own the underlying controls and make sure they actually hold up, not just pass sampling.

  • Partner and customer trust: lead technical responses to third-party questionnaires and partner security reviews alongside GRC.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

  • 8+ years in security engineering, with experience building a security function from early stages

  • Someone who builds and ships controls, not just identifies problems for others to fix

  • Reads and reviews code in production languages (Go, TypeScript, Python, or similar)

  • Detection engineering experience: has built a SIEM or SOAR pipeline from log sources through triage at least once

  • Deep AWS security knowledge: IAM policy design, multi-account strategies, and how cloud privilege escalation works

  • Has operated inside PCI DSS scope and shipped controls that survived a real audit

  • Good judgment on scope: knows when to fix something directly versus set an SLA and hand it to the responsible team

  • Comfortable using AI tools to scale a small security team while working within existing architecture and review processes

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience as the first or early security hire at a high-growth fintech or marketplace

  • Background at companies like Ramp, Mercury, Stripe, Whatnot, or similar fast-scaling environments

  • Experience securing AI and ML systems, model pipelines, or AI-assisted development workflows

jobs.excerpt: Strategic Finance Analyst | M-KOPA You've built three-statement models under deadline pressure for deals that closed, got filed, and were forgotten within a quarter.
jobs.description:
Strategic Finance Analyst | M-KOPA

You've built three-statement models under deadline pressure for deals that closed, got filed, and were forgotten within a quarter. What if the next model you build determined how a company gets 3 million more customers access to credit for the first time?

That's the actual trade-off on the table here.

M-KOPA has just crossed 7 million customers across Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, Uganda, and South Africa, with more than $2 billion in credit unlocked. Of those customers, 55% are accessing formal financial services for the first time, and 86% report a real improvement in their quality of life. We're not a mature business optimising at the margins — we're building the financial infrastructure for the next stage of that growth, from 5 million customers to 7 million, and now toward 10 million.

Why this role exists right now

Every one of those growth milestones has to be modelled, stress-tested, and defended before it becomes a board decision. That's the job of the Strategic Finance team — we own the Long-Range Plan, the market entry business cases, and the analysis that sits behind what the CEO, COO, and board actually decide to do next. As the business scales into new markets and new products, that modelling work is only getting more complex, and more visible. We need someone whose technical rigour can anchor it.

What makes this different from a typical FP&A or banking analyst seat

Most modelling roles either sit inside a bank, building work that ends at deal close, or inside a corporate finance function, running templates someone else designed years ago. This one is neither. You'll be building models from a blank sheet — for market entry decisions, unit economics, distribution cost structures, and funding scenarios — and you'll be doing it in direct partnership with the Head of Strategic Finance, on workstreams that land in front of the CEO and the board within weeks, not quarters. You stay as technical as you were in banking. You just get to see what your numbers actually build.

What you'd own

The core of the role is the company's Long-Range Plan — base, stretch, and market-specific upside/downside scenarios, with the assumptions packs and documentation that leadership and the board rely on. Beyond that, you'll build audit-ready models for special projects as they come up: a new market entry case one month, a distribution cost model the next, a funding analysis after that. You'll be the person who catches the balance sheet or cash flow tie-out break before it reaches the CEO's desk, not after. And you'll support the monthly and quarterly FP&A cycle — budget-vs-actual variance, performance commentary, reporting packs — while helping migrate planning processes into Anaplan as the team scales its tooling across markets.

A good amount of this role is architecture before arithmetic: taking a half-specified problem and figuring out the right model structure before you touch a single formula.

What you'd bring

  • Demonstrable experience building complex, three-statement models from scratch under deadline pressure, ideally from an investment banking, transaction services, or similarly rigorous modelling background

  • A genuine fluency in how operational drivers flow through to financial statements — you don't just build the model, you understand why each line moves the way it does

  • Relentless attention to detail paired with the communication skill to defend your assumptions and explain your logic to someone who's never opened the model

It also helps — though isn't required — if you've worked with Anaplan or another planning platform, have exposure to fintech, lending, or consumer credit, or have worked across multi-currency, multi-entity African businesses.

The honest version

This role moves between workstreams — the Long-Range Plan one week, an ECL question the next, a market entry case after that — often with incomplete information and a deadline that doesn't move. You'll need to get productive on unfamiliar terrain fast, more than once. If that sounds exhausting rather than energising, this probably isn't your seat. If it sounds like exactly the kind of variety your current role doesn't give you, it might be.

Why it's worth the trade-off

You stay deeply technical. Your analysis directly shapes what a high-growth company does next, with executive visibility from day one, and a clear line into senior strategic finance leadership as the team and the business scale together.

If you're reading this and already thinking about how you'd structure the model — that's probably the signal. Let's talk.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.
