jobs.description:
eLearning Developer – Storyline, Animation & Illustration

Location: USA – Remote

About PulseLearning

PulseLearning is an award-winning custom learning provider that creates outcome-focused solutions that have a measurable impact on our clients. Headquartered in Ireland, we have teams in the US, Canada, Europe, and Australia.

We are a one-stop shop for a wide variety of custom learning solutions and services, including eLearning, ILT/VILT, blended learning, live-action and animated video, games, AR/VR, localization, learning strategy, and staff augmentation services.

PulseLearning takes a customer-centric approach, and we are proud of the trusted relationships we have built with our long-standing clients. We are committed to continuing to strengthen these relationships while creating new opportunities for growth.

Position Overview

PulseLearning is seeking a highly skilled eLearning Developer to transform completed instructional design storyboards into polished, engaging, visually compelling, and technically sophisticated digital learning experiences.

This is a hands-on development and visual production role, not an Instructional Designer role. Our Instructional Designers are responsible for learning strategy, content structure, and instructional design. The eLearning Developer is responsible for bringing that vision to life through exceptional technical development, interactivity, animation, illustration, and visual execution.

The ideal candidate is an advanced Articulate Storyline 360 and Rise developer who can move well beyond standard templates. You should be comfortable building custom interactions using variables, triggers, states, branching scenarios, and other advanced Storyline functionality while also bringing strong visual design, animation, and illustration capabilities.

We are looking for someone who takes pride in both the technical quality and visual finish of every learning experience.

Key Responsibilities

eLearning Development

  • Develop engaging and highly polished eLearning courses from completed storyboards provided by Instructional Designers.
  • Build advanced learning experiences using Articulate Storyline 360 and Articulate Rise.
  • Develop sophisticated Storyline interactions using variables, triggers, states, layers, conditions, branching scenarios, and custom interactions.
  • Create interactive learning experiences that go beyond standard templates and out-of-the-box functionality.
  • Develop scenario-based learning, simulations, knowledge checks, assessments, and other interactive learning components.
  • Configure and publish learning content using standards such as SCORM and xAPI.
  • Test and troubleshoot courses to ensure reliable functionality across supported browsers, devices, and learning platforms.
  • Optimize courses for performance, usability, accessibility, and learner experience.

Animation, Illustration & Visual Development

  • Create custom 2D animation, motion graphics, and animated learning elements that enhance learner engagement and understanding.
  • Develop original illustrations, icons, characters, graphics, and other visual assets to support course content.
  • Use tools such as Adobe After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop, or comparable applications to create and enhance digital learning assets.
  • Apply strong visual design principles to ensure consistency, clarity, and high-quality presentation.
  • Translate storyboard concepts into visually engaging learning experiences rather than relying primarily on stock templates or pre-built assets.
  • Maintain a high standard of visual quality and attention to detail throughout the development process.

Advanced & Technical Development

  • Use advanced Storyline functionality to create custom learning interactions and experiences.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues involving course logic, triggers, variables, publishing, LMS compatibility, and learner interactions.
  • Identify creative technical solutions when standard authoring functionality does not meet project requirements.
  • Ensure courses are technically sound, scalable, maintainable, and compatible with client learning environments.

AI-Assisted Development

  • Use modern generative AI and AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency, creativity, and production quality.
  • Apply AI tools appropriately to support visual development, illustration, ideation, asset creation, and development workflows.
  • Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability as new AI capabilities and development technologies emerge.
  • Use AI responsibly and in accordance with client requirements, confidentiality standards, and PulseLearning policies.

Accessibility & Quality Assurance

  • Develop learning experiences with accessibility and usability in mind.
  • Follow accessibility standards and established eLearning development best practices.
  • Conduct thorough functional testing and quality assurance before delivery.
  • Ensure interactions, navigation, animations, graphics, audio, and assessments function as intended.
  • Incorporate feedback from Instructional Designers, Project Managers, Quality teams, and clients while maintaining development quality and consistency.

Collaboration & Project Delivery

  • Work closely with Instructional Designers, Project Managers, graphic designers, animators, and other members of the learning development team.
  • Build courses according to approved storyboards and established project requirements.
  • Communicate proactively regarding technical challenges, development considerations, timelines, and potential solutions.
  • Manage multiple development assignments while meeting agreed project deadlines.
  • Participate in development reviews and incorporate feedback efficiently.
  • Contribute ideas and technical expertise that continuously improve the quality of PulseLearning's digital learning solutions.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Demonstrated professional experience (3+ years) as an eLearning Developer, Storyline Developer, Articulate Developer, Digital Learning Developer, Multimedia Learning Developer, or similar hands-on development role.
  • Advanced proficiency with Articulate Storyline 360, including variables, triggers, states, layers, conditions, branching, and custom interactions.
  • Strong proficiency with Articulate Rise.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop sophisticated eLearning experiences beyond standard templates.
  • Strong skills in 2D animation, motion graphics, and custom animation development.
  • Demonstrated illustration and visual design capabilities, including the ability to create original digital assets.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite tools such as After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop, or comparable applications.
  • Understanding of SCORM and LMS-based course deployment.
  • Experience using modern AI and generative AI tools as part of a digital development workflow.
  • Strong attention to detail and a high standard for visual and technical quality.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively from detailed storyboards and established instructional designs.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Ability to work effectively within a remote, collaborative, and globally distributed team.

Portfolio Requirement

A portfolio or relevant work samples are required for consideration.

Candidates should provide examples demonstrating:

  • Advanced Articulate Storyline development
  • Custom interactions and branching experiences
  • Animation
  • Custom illustration
  • Highly polished finished eLearning courses

We are particularly interested in seeing examples that demonstrate both technical development capability and visual craftsmanship.

Important – This Is a Development Role. This position is focused on eLearning development, technical build, animation, illustration, and visual execution. It is not an Instructional Design or curriculum development position.

Additional Requirements

  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment.
  • Flexibility to collaborate across global teams and time zones as required.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining project timelines and quality standards.

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (0-20 hours per week)

Work Location: Remote – USA

Travel: None

Start Date: Immediately

We look forward to hearing from you!

ABOUT NEW ENERGY NEXUS

New Energy Nexus (NEX) is an international NGO that supports climate solutions and builds a more equitable clean energy economy. Our laser focus is on clean energy entrepreneurs: providing them with funds, accelerators, and networks to thrive. They are our main audience and our agent of change.

We started in California in 2004 and now operate across China, India, Southeast Asia, East and West Africa, and Australia. We have leveraged US$5.4 billion in investment and supported more than 11,000 entrepreneurs.

ABOUT THE ROLE & OPPORTUNITY

The Director of Development Strategy & Operations will lead the internal engine behind New Energy Nexus' global fundraising and business development efforts. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, this role sits at the center of NEX's development team — turning what our development and partnerships staff and country teams learn on the ground with funders into a coherent, prioritized fundraising strategy, and making sure the team is coordinated, resourced, and focused on the highest-value opportunities.

This is not primarily a donor-facing relationship management role. It is a strategy, team leadership, and fundraising operations role for someone who understands the business and fund development cycle deeply enough to translate frontline intelligence — what funders are signaling, what's landing and what isn't, where proposals are stalling, which markets and programs are attracting interest — into clear direction for where the team should spend its time.

The Director will lead and develop NEX's global platform-level development team, ensuring that individual team members' skills and expertise are deployed effectively against organizational priorities, while bringing together the knowledge and fundraising capabilities of country leaders, chapter teams, and program leads. The ideal candidate has the analytical rigor and systems mindset of a strong operations leader, paired with real fluency in philanthropic and development finance fundraising, so they can be a credible internal leader and partner to a globally distributed team of fundraisers, country directors, and program leads.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Fundraising Strategy & Intelligence (50%)

  • Help develop a living, prioritized development strategy based on proposal outcomes, funder conversations, and market signals gleaned from team conversations and learnings from fundraisers, country directors, and program leads
  • Identify where NEX should be focusing time and effort across programs and geographies, based on funder appetite, pipeline strength, and organizational priorities.
  • Maintain a clear view of the funding pipeline across the network — by funder, program, chapter, and stage — and flag risks, gaps, or unrestricted-vs-restricted balance issues early.
  • Translate strategy into concrete guidance: which opportunities to prioritize, which proposals need repositioning, where the team is over- or under-invested.
  • Serve as a thought partner to the CEO and program leads on funding strategy, drawing on patterns across markets rather than any single relationship.

Team Coordination & Enablement (35%)

  • Lead and develop the global platform-level development team including recruiting, hiring, onboarding, coaching, and managing performance, and ensure team members' skills are effectively leveraged against NEX's development priorities.
  • Translate the development strategy into a clear rolling work plan for the team, aligning ownership, resources, and timelines.
  • Build strong collaboration across the global development function, bringing together the expertise and fundraising capabilities of platform-level staff, country leaders, fundraisers, and program leads to maximize collective impact.
  • Run the operating rhythm of the fundraising team: pipeline reviews, proposal coordination across programs/chapters/finance/communications, and prioritization check-ins.
  • Coordinate multi-country and multi-program proposals, including combining country and program inputs into a cohesive narrative and budget that aligns with broader NEX operational and growth priorities.
  • Build and own a central library of fundraising collateral - pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, program summaries, impact data - so materials for funder meetings and conference talks can be assembled quickly rather than built from scratch each time.
  • Draft and maintain core funder and conference decks, adapting a standard set of modular slides/content to each audience so our fundraisers can focus their time on external relationship-building and speaking rather than deck production.
  • Partner with the Chief Communications Officer to keep collateral aligned with current messaging, program updates, and brand standards.
  • Provide country leads and fundraisers with the tools, templates, frameworks, and support to raise funds effectively and report consistently.
  • Build feedback loops so that what is learned through funder and country-level engagement consistently makes its way back into strategy, priorities, and team planning.

Systems, Data & Reporting (15%)

  • Accountable for the fundraising CRM and pipeline-tracking systems, ensuring data quality, consistent use across chapters, and useful reporting.
  • Produce regular and ad hoc reporting and dashboards for NEX leadership on pipeline health, funder trends, and progress against platform fundraising goals.
  • Standardize proposal, reporting, and stewardship templates and processes across the global platform-level team.
  • Track outcomes against the fundraising strategy and refine it as new data comes in.
  • Ensure fundraising protocols and internal as well as external reporting are completed on time and to consistent quality standards

SUCCESS IN THE FIRST 6–12 MONTHS

Success in this role will mean building a more coordinated, strategic, and effective global development function. By the end of the first 6–12 months, the Director will have:

  • Established clear visibility into NEX's global fundraising pipeline, priorities, risks, and opportunities, with leadership able to make decisions based on reliable, current information.
  • Built a strong operating rhythm across the global platform-level development team, with clear ownership, effective collaboration, and team members' skills deployed against the highest-priority fundraising opportunities.
  • Improved coordination across platform, country, and program teams so that high-value proposals are prioritized appropriately, developed collaboratively, and submitted on time and at a consistently high quality.
  • Established consistent CRM and pipeline management practices across the development function, with data being used to inform strategy, prioritization, and reporting.
  • Created a well-organized, accessible library of standardized fundraising collateral and tools that enables fundraisers and country teams to move more quickly and consistently.
  • Established effective feedback loops between funder and country-level intelligence, fundraising performance, and the organization's overall development strategy.

Requirements

Professional Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in fundraising, development operations, or a closely related strategy/operations function (e.g., sales operations, revenue operations, or enablement), with at least 5 years touching nonprofit or philanthropic fundraising directly.
  • Demonstrated experience turning frontline or field-level input into strategy and prioritization.
  • Experience managing or closely coordinating a distributed team, including non-direct-report relationships (e.g., chapter or country-based staff).
  • Strong track record with CRM/pipeline systems and translating data into decisions, not just dashboards.
  • Familiarity with the climate, clean energy, or entrepreneurship support landscape is a strong plus.

Personal Attributes

  • Structured, analytical thinker who is comfortable synthesizing messy, qualitative field input into clear recommendations.
  • High level of adaptability in an environment with evolving team structures and workflows, with a genuine comfort operating in ambiguity - this means being a self-starter and embodying a growth mindset.
  • High emotional intelligence — able to lead and support a development team well, build trust with country leads across diverse cultural contexts, and approach unfamiliar markets and norms with genuine curiosity and cultural sensitivity.
  • Exceptional written communication skills — able to distill complex, multi-market fundraising intelligence into concise strategy and proposals.
  • Strong project management skills; able to run a coordination function across concurrent proposals, deadlines, and stakeholders.
  • Comfortable being an internal partner and "connective tissue" role rather than the primary external face of fundraising.
  • Ability to work with a global team across time zones, with periodic travel for internal team meetings and relevant conferences/convenings.
  • Proficiency in database/CRM management, Google Workspace, and Slack.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Foundational knowledge of global clean energy and climate change solutions and ecosystems and willingness to engage in in-depth self-learning on any gaps.
  • Experience building or adding structure to a development operations function from an earlier, more informal stage.
  • Due to the global nature of the organization and team, some meetings will take place outside of regular work hours.

Benefits

BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION

This is a full-time remote position. Relocation assistance is not available for this role and compensation is competitive for the market the candidate is based in. Applicable benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, paid holidays and insurance will depend on the location of the selected candidate.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.


The Role

We are looking for a Lead Recruiter (Corporate Functions) to lead hiring across Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, Strategy, CEO Office, and other corporate functions globally.

This role combines hands-on recruitment execution with leadership responsibilities. You will partner closely with business leaders to attract high-impact talent, drive hiring strategy, and help build a scalable Talent Acquisition function capable of supporting BJAK’s rapid global growth.

You will play a critical role in shaping the organization by hiring exceptional talent while mentoring junior recruiters and establishing recruiting best practices across the business.

Business Recruitment Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end recruitment process for business and corporate functions globally, including Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, CEO Office, and other key functions.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring priorities, organizational needs, role requirements, and workforce planning strategies.

  • Act as a trusted talent advisor by providing market intelligence, compensation insights, hiring recommendations, and talent market trends.

  • Lead recruitment efforts for senior, niche, confidential, and business-critical positions across multiple regions.

  • Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies to attract high-caliber passive candidates in competitive talent markets.

Talent Pipeline & Market Intelligence

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines across key business functions to support both current and future hiring needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping exercises across target companies, industries, and markets.

  • Develop strong understanding of global labor markets, compensation trends, and talent availability across multiple countries.

Team Development & Process Excellence

  • Mentor and support junior recruiters, helping improve sourcing effectiveness, candidate assessment quality, and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • Establish recruiting best practices, interview calibration standards, sourcing frameworks, and hiring processes across business functions.

  • Review recruitment performance, pipeline quality, and hiring outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Support the development and scaling of the global Talent Acquisition team.

Recruitment Operations & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate ATS data, candidate records, and recruitment reporting.

  • Track recruitment metrics including pipeline health, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, offer acceptance rates, and hiring quality.

  • Ensure a professional, positive, and consistent candidate experience across all recruitment stages.

  • Support compliance with local labor regulations and recruitment best practices across multiple regions.


The Right Fit Has

  • 5-8 years of full-cycle recruitment experience across multiple business and corporate functions.

  • Proven success recruiting for functions such as Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, Strategy, Consulting, CEO Office, or other business-critical roles.

  • Demonstrated ability to hire senior, niche, and difficult-to-fill positions across multiple markets.

  • Strong expertise in sourcing passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, networking, talent mapping, referrals, and other advanced sourcing techniques.

  • Experience managing multiple high-priority requisitions simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence hiring decisions and challenge hiring assumptions when necessary.

  • Experience partnering with senior leaders on hiring strategy, organizational design discussions, and workforce planning initiatives.

  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or guiding junior recruiters is highly preferred.

  • Familiarity with global hiring practices, compensation structures, and recruitment across multiple countries.

  • Strong proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment analytics.

  • Excellent communication, project management, and relationship-building skills.

  • Experience in high-growth technology companies, startups, internet businesses, consulting firms, or fast-scaling organizations is strongly preferred.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently delivers high-quality hires across multiple business functions and regions.

  • Builds sustainable talent pipelines for critical and hard-to-fill business roles.

  • Becomes a trusted advisor to business leaders and hiring managers.

  • Improves recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and candidate experience.

  • Successfully develops junior recruiters and contributes to building a scalable Talent Acquisition function.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, ambitious hiring goals, and a high degree of ownership.


Why Join BJAK

  • Above-market remuneration.

  • Fast-track career growth and leadership opportunities.

  • High ownership, autonomy, and direct impact on business growth.

  • Exposure to global hiring across multiple countries and functions.

  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership on critical business hiring initiatives.

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Solutions Engineer

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Solutions Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Solutions Engineer, you are the technical owner of the merchant relationship from first sales conversation through live integration and beyond. You will focus on our enterprise and strategic merchants: the national retailers and high-volume brands running custom, hand-built integrations across web, mobile app, and in-store. These are our most complex merchants and our largest revenue drivers, and they do not come with an off-the-shelf plugin.

You will partner with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope what a merchant needs, design the integration that gets them there, and stay with them once they are live. You own the technical side of pre-sales: demos, architecture discussions, RFP responses, and solution proposals. When a merchant needs something custom, you define the requirement, shape the solution with our engineering team, and drive it to launch.

This is a customer-facing engineering role. You will spend as much time on calls with merchant developers as you will in documentation and test environments, and you need to be credible in both rooms.

This role combines technical expertise and sales acumen to support sales teams. They work closely with the sales team and clients, understanding customer needs and translating them into effective, tailored solutions. Acting as a bridge between technical and business functions, a Solutions Engineer not only helps demonstrate and implement the product’s capabilities but also communicates complex technical details in a way that resonates with clients. Their role requires both the ability to engage with customers directly and the technical know-how to ensure the product meets client requirements effectively.

What You'll Do:

  • Own technical discovery for prospective merchants: understand their stack, their checkout flow, and their constraints, then map them to the right Sezzle integration path
  • Lead product demos and technical presentations for merchant engineering and business stakeholders
  • Design integration solutions across our API, SDKs, and platform plugins (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix, and custom builds)
  • Write technical proposals and complete RFP and security questionnaire responses
  • Support merchant mobile app integrations: SDK implementation, in-app checkout, and native versus webview handoff
  • Validate integrations in sandbox and in production before launch, including checkout flow, widget and messaging placement, redirect and handoff behavior, and settlement
  • Troubleshoot live integration issues alongside Support and Engineering, and own the technical narrative back to the merchant
  • Translate recurring merchant needs into product feedback, and push for the fixes that unblock revenue
  • Build and maintain integration documentation, runbooks, and internal enablement so the team scales without you in every call
  • Act as the trusted technical advisor for your merchants after launch, spotting optimization opportunities they haven't asked for yet

What We Look For:

  • 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role: solutions engineering, sales engineering, implementation, solutions architecture, or technical account management
  • Experience with mobile SDK integrations on iOS and Android, including the ability to guide merchant mobile developers through implementation and debug what breaks
  • Experience supporting enterprise merchants through complex, multi-stakeholder integrations with custom-built commerce stacks
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and reading API documentation critically
  • Working knowledge of web technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Familiarity with at least one major e-commerce platform (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix) and how payment methods integrate into it
  • Understanding of e-commerce workflows: cart, checkout, payment authorization and capture, refunds, shipping, and product management
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, and business context clearly to engineers
  • Strong written communication. You will produce documentation and proposals that merchants and internal teams rely on
  • Comfort managing several merchant integrations at once in a fast-moving environment
  • Ability to read code in at least one language well enough to debug a merchant's implementation
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively in day-to-day work, including research, technical documentation, problem-solving, and workflow automation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a payments company, PSP, or BNPL provider
  • Familiarity with payment gateway architecture and how alternative payment methods are surfaced at checkout
  • Experience with in-store or omnichannel payment integrations
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.excerpt: About UsEvery year, millions die from preventable diseases because vital services do not reach them.
jobs.description:
About Us

Every year, millions die from preventable diseases because vital services do not reach them. A root cause is broken data: missing or unreliable IDs, fragmented records, and inflated reporting. Without accurate data on who receives services, governments and NGOs cannot deliver care effectively, track impact, or target life-saving resources.

Simprints is a nonprofit tech company that partners with ministries and funders to verify identities, digitise workflows, and enable evidence-based decisions so the right services reach the right people at the right time. We co-design end-to-end digital solutions with the people who use them, from the frontlines to national dashboards. Our biometric products integrate with health records to drive accuracy, accountability, and insights.

We build for scale with privacy-first, open-source, and cost-effective technology that strengthens national digital public infrastructure. Studies have shown that Simprints increases impact through real-time, precision data, for example, increasing maternal health visits by 38% in Bangladesh or accurate HIV tracing by 62% in Malawi. To date, we’ve worked in over 17 countries, helping deliver health, aid, and finance to over 4 million people.

Our mission is simple: make sure every vaccine, every dollar, and every public good reaches the people who need them most.

About the Role

The Partnerships Operations Manager will help build the operating engine behind Simprints’ growth. This role will support the Partnerships team to identify, qualify, and progress high-value opportunities more effectively, while improving the systems, data, and automation that underpin our revenue generation.

You will sit at the intersection of sales operations, market intelligence, AI-enabled automation, and proposal development. One day you might be improving our CRM and pipeline reporting; the next, building an AI-assisted workflow to scan donor opportunities; the next, coordinating inputs for a grant application or preparing a funder brief.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys creating structure, improving processes, and helping senior relationship-holders move faster and more strategically. You will make the Partnerships team sharper, more disciplined, and better equipped to grow a healthy and diversified pipeline.

Job Details

  • Job Title: Partnerships Operations Manager
  • Reporting To: Chief Strategy Officer
  • Grade: UK Grade IC5 - Up to £45,000
  • Location: Remote

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  1. Manage and improve Partnerships systems and pipeline operations
    Revamp our CRM engine and maintain CRM hygiene, pipeline data, opportunity and task tracking, dashboards, and reporting so the team has clear visibility on priorities, risks, next steps, and revenue forecasts.
  2. Build AI-enabled automation for growth and fundraising workflows
    Design practical automations to support funder scanning, opportunity alerts, donor research, meeting preparation, proposal content development, follow-up tracking, and pipeline reporting.
  3. Scout and qualify new opportunities
    Monitor the market for relevant grants, RFPs, funder calls, innovation challenges, and strategic partnership opportunities, using clear criteria to assess fit, competitiveness, revenue potential, impact, and internal effort required.
  4. Support grant applications and proposal development
    Coordinate timelines, internal inputs, compliance checks, and supporting materials for proposals and funder submissions; draft or refine selected sections where needed.
  5. Strengthen market, funder, and partner intelligence
    Produce concise research outputs such as funder briefs, opportunity summaries, country or sector snapshots, partner maps, and go/no-go recommendations to support better decision-making.

Skills and experience

  1. Must have experience specifically in a mission-driven, technology, global health, or international development context in sales operations, growth operations, fundraising operations, business development operations,
  2. Strong systems and process skills, including experience managing CRMs, pipelines, dashboards, spreadsheets, trackers, or workflow tools.
  3. Confidence using AI and automation tools to improve team efficiency, reduce manual work, and create scalable processes.
  4. Excellent research, analytical, and synthesis skills, with the ability to turn complex market or funder information into clear recommendations.
  5. Strong written communication and project coordination skills, including the ability to support proposals, support and produce presentations, funder briefs, internal decision documents, and cross-team deadlines.

How we work
We confront the grey. We practise transparency and radical candour, listen deeply, share information openly, and speak up when our ethical compass is challenged, so that psychological safety is real and everyone can do their best work.

We leave our egos at the door. We bring curiosity, kindness, and a positive attitude, seek first to understand, and remember to laugh together. We stay humble about our small part in big global problems, and we remain bold about our ambition to drive change.

We find a way. We plan with clear strategies, deliverables, deadlines, and metrics, step out of our comfort zones, and make it happen. When a plan is not working, we learn from the data, adapt quickly, and keep moving in service of the mission.

We remember why we are here. Impact for people comes first. We act like owners, hold ourselves to high standards, and work across teams to close data gaps and increase coverage, so the right services reach the right people at the right time.

We celebrate the differences. We treat every person with compassion, empathy, and respect, build inclusive spaces where diverse perspectives are welcomed, involve people in important decisions, and share credit generously, because our best ideas can come from anywhere.

Benefits

5 Reasons to Join Simprints

Life is short. We believe work should be inspirational, meaningful and fun. At Simprints, we’re taking on global development’s biggest challenges, powered by an amazing culture and incredible people. Work with us, and you will grow faster, learn more, and take on great responsibilities with the potential to make lasting change.

1. Genuine Impact. Work directly with our partners and users to deliver technology that has the potential to impact millions of lives across the globe. At Simprints, you’ll be part of a team that is passionate about driving real change.

2. An incredible, diverse team. Our work is at the intersection of technology and global development, and we’ve managed to build an amazing team drawn from all over the world. But don’t take our word for it—we’re an externally recognised as a Great Place to Work, and a 2025 Best Workplace for Women amonst many other accolades.

3. Mutual Flex. We champion a work culture where autonomy and trust are paramount, steering clear of mere face-time metrics. Whether it's managing life's essentials like healthcare appointments or adapting work hours to match your peak productivity times, we've got you covered. In return, we count on your reciprocal flexibility when mission-critical moments arise, like stepping up for a crucial client discussion on a Friday or tackling unexpected technical glitches beyond regular hours.

4. Ultimate work-life balance.

    1. We offer a 4-day workweek, meaning everybody has the option to have Fridays off.
    2. We also offer unlimited annual leave, which allows you to prioritise your well-being

As long as you're driving results and fostering teamwork, we encourage you to strike that perfect balance between your professional and personal life. Our commitment to this model's success is solidified through semi-annual productivity assessments with our board, ensuring that our high standards of performance are consistently met.

5. Professional development. We promote continual learning and put our money where our mouth is with development plans and access to global experts through the GLG network

We also have a generous professional development budget for each colleague – “Eduprints”. Is there some training you’d like, or maybe you could benefit from professional coaching? Simply provide a business case that shares your aspirations and the resources you need, and we'll do our best to support you.

We care about both your development in Simprints and your holistic long-term career goals. Simprints Alumni have gone on to work for Google, World Bank, Gavi the vaccine alliance, Save the Children, and other top players.

The American Marketing Association is looking for an Enterprise Partnerships Lead!

Who We Are

About the American Marketing Association (AMA)

As the leading global professional marketing association, the AMA is the essential community for marketers. From students and practitioners to executives and academics, we aim to elevate the profession, deepen knowledge, and make a lasting impact. The AMA is home to five premier scholarly journals, including: Journal of Marketing, Journal of Marketing Research, Journal of Public Policy and Marketing, Journal of International Marketing, and Journal of Interactive Marketing. Our industry-leading training events and conferences define future-forward practices, while our professional development and PCM® professional certification advance knowledge. With 70 chapters and a presence on 350 college campuses across North America, the AMA fosters a vibrant community of marketers. The association's philanthropic arm, the AMA’s Foundation, is inspiring a more diverse industry and ensuring marketing research impacts public good.

AMA views marketing as the activity, set of institutions, and processes for creating, communicating, delivering, and exchanging offerings that have value for customers, clients, partners, and society at large. You can learn more about AMA’s learning programs and certifications, conferences and events, and scholarly journals at AMA.org.

What to know about this role

  • This role sits within AMA's Alliances team, a primary revenue engine of the AMA and critical driver of our mission. We partner with leading brands to develop strategic, business-focused partnerships that elevate their thought leadership, connect them with our community, and help them achieve meaningful business outcomes. The revenue our team generates directly fuels AMA's ability to serve marketers, students, and educators around the world.
  • We are a fully remote organization with team members in over 20 states within the US. Work from the comfort of your home, a local coffee shop, or wherever in the U.S. brings you joy! However, please note that you MUST live in one of the following states to be considered for this role:
    • Alabama, Colorado, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, North Carolina, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington, or Wisconsin!

  • Compensation includes a $65,000 base salary plus an uncapped commission plan designed to reward new business growth. Successful performers have the opportunity to earn $100,000+ in their first year, with significant upside for top performers.

The impact of this role

This is a rare seat: the chance to build something that doesn’t exist yet inside of one of marketing’s most trusted organizations. You’ll go beyond traditional sponsorship sales, drawing on our full ecosystem of research, membership, events, and thought leadership to solve real business challenges for enterprise partners. You’ll work across the AMA to design partnerships and open up new revenue streams. If you want to build something scalable and see your fingerprints on the AMA’s growth for years to come, this is that role.

What you’ll be doing

  • Drive new business growth by identifying, developing, and closing strategic partnership opportunities across AMA's sponsorship, advertising, research, events, executive engagement, and other organizational assets.
  • Build and manage a high-quality sales pipeline through strategic prospecting, networking, referrals, and market research to consistently achieve revenue goals.
  • Develop consultative partnership solutions by understanding client business objectives and designing customized programs that create value for both partners and AMA.
  • Collaborate across the organization to develop, deliver, and optimize partnership opportunities while sharing market insights that shape future growth strategies.
  • Grow long-term partner relationships by demonstrating ROI, identifying expansion opportunities, and driving renewals.
  • Manage the sales process with excellence by maintaining accurate Salesforce records, forecasts, proposals, contracts, and other sales documentation.

What you bring to the table

  • 5–7+ years of experience in B2B consultative sales, partnerships, or business development with a track record of closing new business.

  • 5 years of experience using Salesforce (or another CRM) to manage pipeline and forecast accurately.
  • Highly self-motivated with an entrepreneurial mindset and a bias toward action.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to develop compelling client proposals.

What you may also have

  • Experience selling into enterprise organizations or Fortune 1000 companies.
  • Familiarity with nonprofit, association, higher education, or membership organizations.

What we offer

jobs.description:
JustPlay is looking for an experienced and business-oriented Founders Associate - Engagement Innovation to help us make JustPlay app ecosystem dramatically more fun, exciting and engaging.

You'll work directly with our founders across every product team, constantly looking for ideas that make users want to click, play, win, explore and come back.

We're not looking for someone to manage roadmaps or introduce more product processes. We're looking for someone with exceptional consumer instincts, extremely high agency and an obsession with the mechanics behind the world's most engaging B2C products.

You should be the kind of person who opens an app like TikTok, Temu, MONOPOLY GO!, Duolingo or Whatnot and immediately starts dissecting why it works and how those ideas could be applied somewhere completely different.

Some of your ideas may become major features. Others might be a different CTA, a more exciting reward reveal, a new event, better framing of a prize, or an experiment we can ship next week.

We care much more about the impact of an idea than its complexity.

Job Responsibilities

  • Work directly with the founders as a thinking partner on what makes JustPlay exciting to play

  • Embed across product teams to find opportunities — not to run them

  • Maintain a constant flow of ideas, from single-line copy changes to entirely new mechanics

  • Tear down the world's most engaging consumer apps and translate what works there into what could work here

  • Turn ideas into things people can act on: a sharp one-pager, a mock, a test plan — whatever gets it moving fastest

  • Push ideas through to launch by making yourself useful to the teams shipping them

  • Measure what happens, tell the truth about it, and scale or kill accordingly

  • Build our collective instinct for engagement, so the whole company gets better at this over time

Job Requirements

  • Exceptional consumer instincts: you can tell why something is fun or addictive, not just that it is

  • Extremely high agency: you find the problem, propose the answer, and chase it until it's live, without being assigned it

  • A genuine obsession with engagement mechanics in top B2C products such as games, social, commerce, or education

  • Evidence that your ideas have shipped and moved a number, however small the idea was

  • Fluency with data: you can read an experiment result honestly, including when it kills your favourite idea

  • You write and speak clearly enough to sell an idea to a founder and an engineer in the same afternoon

  • Comfortable being the newest voice in a room of people who know the product better than you and disagreeing anyway

  • You communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken

Nice to Have

  • Casual, hyper-casual, or rewarded mobile gaming experience

  • Background in LiveOps: events, seasons, progression, economies, or meta design

  • Hands-on experimentation experience: you've designed and read A/B tests

  • Enough technical or design literacy to mock something up yourself rather than describe it

  • Familiarity with loyalty and rewards mechanics, or the mobile advertising landscape

Job benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc.

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, freeWellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

* Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

jobs.excerpt: Our mission is to become the global standard for addressing.
jobs.description:
Our mission is to become the global standard for addressing. Street addresses weren’t designed for 2026. They aren’t accurate enough to specify building entrances, and they don’t exist for parks, rural areas and many parts of the world. This makes it hard to find places and causes problems and inefficiencies on a global scale.

That’s why we created what3words. We divided the world into 3m squares and gave each square a unique combination of three words. It’s the easiest way to find and share precise locations.

Over the last year, what3words has been used in 193 countries, and our monthly active users continue to grow at an impressive pace. Our tech is used by emergency services, delivery companies, eCommerce businesses, ride-hailing apps and NGOs, and is integrated into the navigation systems of millions of cars around the world.

Who we’re looking for

Based in Vietnam out of our centrally located Ho Chi Minh City office, we’re looking for a talented Product Designer to join our Product team, where you’ll work closely with Engineers and Product Managers to design products that are simple but great for the user, focusing on interaction, understanding and visual design.

We are looking for a critical thinker with an excellent visual and interaction design sense and an eye for making things better while working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Role Overview

California's energy code requires a third-party field verification step, a HERS or ECC test, for most HVAC permits. It's a fragmented, manual, and under-served market. PermitFlow is entering it.

We're looking for someone who has run a HERS/ECC operation before. This role isn't for a field technician; it's for an operator who understands the rater market, knows the unit economics, has relationships with raters across California, and can build a statewide network from the ground up. This is the first hire in this function, reporting directly to the COO.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own the statewide ECC-Rater network. Contract 2+ qualified rater firms across all major CA metros (LA/Orange County, San Diego, Bay Area, Sacramento/Central Valley, Inland Empire). Set commercial terms, SLAs, capacity commitments, and offboarding criteria.

  • Own Provider relationships. Manage PermitFlow's relationships with all three CA ECC Provider registries: CHEERS and Golden State Registry (GSR). These are the credentialing and oversight bodies for every rater in the network.

  • Build and run the QA program. Credential verification, E&O insurance review, pass rate tracking, SLA auditing, and rater performance scorecards. Hold or hire 1-2 certified ECC-Raters for technical and QA standards.

  • Be the technical voice in enterprise sales. Join calls with large HVAC customers where HERS/ECC capability is a key decision factor. You're the reason a customer believes PermitFlow can execute at volume.

  • Monitor the HERS-to-ECC transition. California's HERS program officially became the Energy Code Compliance (ECC) program in January 2026. You stay on top of Title 20 rulemaking and what it means for our network and operations.

  • Evaluate strategic options. Including potential acquisition targets where acquiring a rater firm accelerates coverage.

What We're Looking For

  • HERS/ECC operator: You've run a permit + HERS/ECC + rebate operation, not as a field technician, but as the person responsible for the network, the workflow, and the results. You understand what drives pass rates, SLA performance, and rater economics.

  • CA market native: You have real relationships in the CA rater market. You know who the raters are in Sacramento, the Bay Area, LA, and San Diego. You can get on the phone with CHEERS (and others) and get things done.

  • Network builder: You've built or managed a multi-vendor, multi-metro network of inspectors or raters. You know how to vet, contract, and if necessary, off-board a partner.

  • Builder orientation: There is no inherited infrastructure here. You're writing the playbook, setting the QA bar, designing the vendor contracts, and deciding who's in the network. You've done this before and you're good at it.

  • Technical credibility in customer conversations: You can sit across from a VP of Operations at a large HVAC company and speak with authority about HERS/ECC testing workflows, rater capacity, and what makes a compliant inspection. This is not a sales role, but your presence on a call needs to close the credibility gap.

If it’s a thing, we’re working to connect it.Join Impinj and help us realize our vision of a boundless IoT— connecting trillions of everyday items to the Internet.

Team Overview:

The RAIN Reader IC (RIC) design group is part of the Impinj Silicon Engineering department and is responsible for the development of Impinj’s RIC products. Within the RIC Design group, the digital team owns the digital subsystems of these products, including the digital modem, the microcontroller subsystem, digital control loops, calibration engines, and the control and interface logic for analog IP. The team carries these designs from architecture and micro-architecture definition through RTL, verification, DFT, and timing closure to tapeout, post-silicon bring-up, and validation, partnering closely with chip architects, RF/analog designers, physical design, and CAD/EDA engineers and using state-of-the-art tools and methodologies. The team works to balance short-term goals needed to deliver products rapidly to market and long-term enhancements to methodologies and practices to enable future efficiencies.

What You'll Do:

  • Drive the digital design of Impinj's next-generation RAIN RFID Reader ICs from architecture through tapeout and silicon validation.
  • Develop micro-architectures, create executable models, and implement RTL for complex digital and mixed-signal IC subsystems.
  • Collaborate with chip architects and RF/analog engineers to partition and realize advanced mixed-signal architectures, including digital control loops, calibration engines, and interface logic for analog IP.
  • Partner with physical design and verification teams to ensure timing closure, signal integrity, and delivery of production-ready Reader ICs.
  • Define and implement DFT strategies — including scan insertion, BIST, and boundary scan — appropriate for mixed-signal Reader IC designs.
  • Work with CAD/EDA engineers to evolve Impinj's ASIC/SoC design flows, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Enhance existing RAIN RFID Reader products with new features, performance improvements, and power optimizations.
  • Support post-silicon bring-up and debug, correlating RTL and simulation results with lab measurements to validate design intent.

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, with 12 years of experience (or 8 years with MS or 5 years with a PhD) required.
  • 12+ years of RTL design experience, including at least 2–3 full tapeout cycles preferably on mixed-signal or RF-integrated ICs.
  • Strong skills in digital logic design, micro-architecture definition, synthesis, and timing closure.
  • Proficiency in Verilog and SystemVerilog for RTL development, behavioral modeling, and verification.
  • Solid understanding of digital design methodologies including CDC analysis, clock gating, low-power design (UPF/CPF), and static timing analysis.
  • Experience with UVM-based verification, functional coverage, assertion-based verification, and DFT implementation (scan, MBIST, ATPG).
  • Scripting proficiency in Python, Perl, or UNIX shell for flow automation and design productivity.
  • Proven ability to lead technical workstreams, mentor junior engineers, and communicate effectively across analog, digital, and systems disciplines.

  • Conducts regular internal audits and gap analyses across trading, scheduling, settlements, and operations functions for multi-market compliance exposure.

Working Conditions:

95% of time is spent in the office environment utilizing computers (frequent use of various Microsoft software/programs), phones, and general office equipment. 5% of time is spent outside of the office visiting vendors’ and/or internal customers’ sites in addition to attending various conferences and meetings.

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.


The Opportunity: Senior Credit Manager, US Core

Tilt is looking for a Senior Manager to support our Cash Advance business, one of our largest and most established product lines. You'll work at the intersection of credit policy, model development, and product strategy, helping us maintain the rigor and velocity of our existing credit programs while supporting a growing agenda of new product experimentation. This is an individual-contributor role with outsized visibility: you won't manage a team, but you will regularly partner with and influence senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders across the business.

This role is a great fit for someone who wants deep ownership of high-impact analytical work and who's energized by moving between rigorous quantitative analysis and creative, ambiguous conceptual problems.


How You'll Make an Impact

  • Sustain credit model and policy velocity: Support the ongoing development and refinement of credit models and underwriting policies for Cash Advance, helping maintain quality and pace as the program evolves.

  • Drive new product experimentation: Partner on the design and evaluation of new product constructs and pricing approaches, bringing rigorous credit analysis to test-and-learn initiatives that are still taking shape.

  • Bridge new product experiences and credit rigor: Bring both a user/product lens and a quantitative credit policy lens to new initiatives — helping ideas move from concept to tested, scalable strategy.

  • Communicate with precision and influence: Translate complex analysis into clear, decision-ready recommendations for senior stakeholders, and build the credibility to shape decisions without formal authority.

  • Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with data science, product, marketing and other credit and risk functions to keep initiatives moving and aligned with the broader business strategy.

  • Bring creativity and structure to ambiguous problems: Help scope and structure new analytical questions where the path isn't yet defined, and move initiatives forward with urgency and independent judgment.


Why You're a Great Fit

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Engineering, Business, Finance, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or similar); advanced degree a plus.

  • 5-7 years of experience in credit risk, data analytics, or a related quantitative discipline, ideally in consumer lending or fintech.

  • Excellent communication skills — able to go deep in the analytical weeds and also distill findings clearly for an executive audience.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and build trust with senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners without formal reporting authority.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving instincts, with comfort operating in ambiguity and a track record of driving projects forward independently.

  • A creative, action-oriented approach — someone who prototypes, tests, and iterates rather than waiting for a fully-defined brief.

  • Eagerness to learn new tools and methods, and to stay current with trends in credit, lending, and AI.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

jobs.description:
ISP Network Support Engineer (BGP, MikroTik, Peplink, SD-WAN & Wireless) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
On-Call: Rotating after-hours emergency support — approximately 1 week per month

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring an ISP Network Support Engineer for one of our clients to support customer-facing troubleshooting and production network operations across a growing multi-WAN ISP environment.

This is not a basic helpdesk role. You’ll work directly with live network infrastructure across fiber, fixed wireless, bonded WAN, Starlink, and SD-WAN deployments, troubleshooting complex connectivity issues and maintaining reliable, high-availability services.

You’ll work hands-on with technologies including MikroTik RouterOS, Peplink SpeedFusion, BGP, OSPF, Cambium, Ubiquiti, Siklu, Aviat, and enterprise wireless infrastructure.

This role is particularly well suited to someone with hands-on ISP, WISP, FTTH, or MSP experience who is comfortable troubleshooting production networks while communicating directly with customers.

What You’ll Own

Customer Network Support & Troubleshooting

  • Diagnose customer issues involving:
    • Connectivity and outages
    • Latency and packet loss
    • Routing instability
    • VoIP and call-quality problems
    • WAN and failover performance
  • Troubleshoot bonded WAN, SD-WAN, VPN, VLAN, and wireless connectivity issues.
  • Support routers, firewalls, and Customer Premise Equipment (CPE).
  • Investigate issues across multiple layers rather than simply escalating tickets.
  • Document troubleshooting steps, root causes, and configuration changes.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly to business customers.
  • Advise customers on redundancy, failover, and network optimization.
  • Participate in rotating after-hours emergency support.

ISP Network Operations

  • Monitor and maintain:
    • Edge routing infrastructure
    • Wireless backhaul systems
    • Bonded WAN infrastructure
    • Core ISP services
  • Provision and configure customer network deployments.
  • Configure:
    • Routers
    • VLANs
    • Firewall rules
    • NAT
    • QoS
    • VPNs
  • Diagnose BGP and OSPF routing issues, routing loops, WAN instability, and failover events.
  • Maintain configuration backups, firmware updates, IP documentation, and network hardening standards.

MikroTik, Peplink & SD-WAN

  • Configure and troubleshoot MikroTik RouterOS environments.
  • Support Peplink SpeedFusion and InControl2.
  • Troubleshoot multi-WAN bonding and failover behavior.
  • Support hybrid connectivity involving:
    • Fiber
    • Fixed wireless
    • Starlink
    • 5G
    • Terrestrial WAN connections
  • Optimize redundancy and high-availability configurations.

Fixed Wireless & Backhaul Infrastructure

  • Support fixed wireless environments using:
    • Cambium
    • Ubiquiti
    • PTP/PMP architectures
  • Work with high-capacity wireless backhaul technologies including:
    • Siklu
    • Aviat
    • mmWave infrastructure
  • Support tower deployments, backhaul upgrades, and infrastructure expansion.
  • Troubleshoot signal, connectivity, capacity, and backhaul performance issues.

VoIP & QoS

  • Troubleshoot SIP and VoIP quality issues.
  • Diagnose network conditions affecting voice traffic.
  • Configure and optimize QoS policies.
  • Prioritize latency-sensitive traffic appropriately.
  • Help maintain consistent voice quality across multi-WAN environments.

Documentation & Configuration Management

  • Maintain accurate:
    • Network diagrams
    • IP documentation
    • Device configurations
    • Troubleshooting records
    • Configuration backups
  • Document root-cause findings and remediation steps.
  • Keep infrastructure documentation current following network changes.
  • Help reduce repeat incidents through accurate documentation and preventative improvements.

Technical Environment

You may work across:

Routing & Networking

  • MikroTik RouterOS
  • BGP
  • OSPF
  • TCP/IP
  • VLANs
  • NAT
  • QoS
  • VPNs

SD-WAN & Multi-WAN

  • Peplink
  • SpeedFusion
  • InControl2
  • Starlink
  • 5G
  • WAN bonding and failover

Wireless & Backhaul

  • Cambium
  • Ubiquiti
  • Siklu
  • Aviat
  • PTP/PMP
  • mmWave

Enterprise Wi-Fi

  • Cambium cnMaestro
  • UniFi

Voice

  • SIP
  • VoIP
  • QoS and voice optimization

Required Experience & Skills

  • Hands-on networking experience within an ISP, WISP, FTTH, MSP, or similar production network environment.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting:
    • Routing
    • Switching
    • WAN connectivity
    • Network outages
    • Failover systems
  • Hands-on experience configuring:
    • Routers
    • Firewalls
    • VLANs
    • VPNs
  • Strong understanding of:
    • TCP/IP
    • NAT
    • QoS
    • VLANs
    • BGP
    • OSPF
  • Ability to troubleshoot live production networking issues methodically.
  • Strong documentation and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and customers.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability for rotating after-hours emergency support.

Strongly Preferred

  • Hands-on MikroTik RouterOS expertise.
  • Experience with Peplink, SpeedFusion, and InControl2.
  • Experience with:
    • Cambium
    • Ubiquiti
    • Siklu
    • Aviat
  • Fixed wireless or WISP deployment experience.
  • PTP/PMP and mmWave backhaul experience.
  • Starlink or hybrid WAN experience.
  • VoIP troubleshooting experience involving:
    • SIP
    • QoS
    • Voice-quality optimization
  • Experience supporting multi-WAN and high-availability network environments.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’ve worked on real production networks, not only lab environments.
  • You can troubleshoot complex connectivity problems without immediately escalating them.
  • You understand how routing, WAN links, wireless infrastructure, and failover interact.
  • You remain calm and methodical during outages.
  • You care about uptime, redundancy, and network reliability.
  • You can explain complex network problems clearly to customers.
  • You take ownership of an issue through diagnosis and resolution.
  • You proactively look for ways to prevent repeat incidents.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Troubleshooting customer connectivity, latency, and routing issues.
  • Investigating BGP/OSPF or multi-WAN failover problems.
  • Configuring MikroTik routers, VLANs, VPNs, firewalls, and QoS.
  • Monitoring wireless backhaul and ISP infrastructure.
  • Provisioning new customer connections.
  • Troubleshooting Peplink SpeedFusion or bonded WAN deployments.
  • Investigating VoIP quality issues.
  • Supporting infrastructure expansions and network upgrades.
  • Updating configuration records and network diagrams.
  • Coordinating with engineering and field teams on escalations.

In short: you help keep production ISP infrastructure stable, scalable, and highly available while solving complex customer and network issues across modern wired, wireless, and SD-WAN environments.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Fast and accurate ticket resolution.
  • High network uptime and reliability.
  • Reduced repeat incidents and escalations.
  • Successful customer provisioning.
  • Effective resolution of routing and failover issues.
  • Accurate network documentation and configuration management.
  • Strong customer satisfaction and communication quality.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Hands-on exposure to real ISP/WISP production infrastructure.
  • Work directly with BGP, MikroTik, Peplink, SD-WAN, wireless backhaul, and multi-WAN environments.
  • Exposure to modern connectivity technologies including Starlink and hybrid WAN.
  • Strong technical ownership rather than basic Tier 1 support.
  • Opportunity to work across both customer-facing troubleshooting and infrastructure operations.
  • Clear growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Network Engineer
    • ISP Network Engineer
    • Infrastructure Engineer
    • Network Operations Lead
    • Network Architect

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening Call
  • Technical Interview
  • Practical Network Troubleshooting Scenario
  • Final Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you have hands-on ISP/WISP networking experience, understand BGP, MikroTik, multi-WAN, SD-WAN, and wireless infrastructure, and enjoy solving complex production networking problems, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help maintain reliable, high-performance connectivity across modern ISP and hybrid network environments.

About Us

At Quartermaster AI, we leverage cutting-edge AI and robotics technology to enhance maritime domain awareness. Our mission is to become the eyes, ears, and brain of the ocean by enabling every vessel to collaboratively sense, compute, and communicate. Quartermaster is a venture-backed Maritime Domain Awareness company providing near real-time insights to government and commercial partners via our SmartMast product. SmartMast is a COTS sensor system consisting of a camera, a software defined radio, and a proprietary onboard AI component installed on vessels worldwide, and managed by Quartermaster.

About the Role

As Head of Launch for Africa, you will lead Quartermaster's expansion across one of the world's most diverse and fast-evolving maritime regions. This is a high-stakes, dual-mandate role: you will serve as our chief diplomat and operational strategist. You will be responsible for proactively de-risking our business across a wide range of jurisdictions and regulatory regimes, while identifying and securing the maritime partnerships that anchor Quartermaster's growth. Success in this role is measured in SmartMast™ units installed, activated, and reporting on Africa’s coastal waters.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Strategy & Market De-risking

  • Government & Regulatory Relations: Build and maintain proactive relationships with national maritime authorities, port authorities, and regional bodies across Africa’s varied regulatory landscape.
  • Policy & Compliance Mapping: Anticipate regulatory shifts, trade restrictions, and policy changes across the continent's overlapping port state control regimes, including the Abuja MoU and Indian Ocean MoU, along with continent-wide frameworks such as the African Union’s 2050 Africa’s Integrated Maritime Strategy, and develop strategies to neutralize risks before they impact operations.
  • Compliance Leadership: Partner with Legal and Compliance to ensure every market launch aligns with local labor, customs, trade, spectrum and equipment type-approval, data handling, and maritime safety requirements.

Market Entry & Local Infrastructure

  • Market Entry Playbooks: Develop scalable, repeatable launch strategies adaptable to the political, economic, and infrastructure realities of individual African markets.
  • Import & Logistics Setup: Establish the import, customs, and logistics framework needed to bring SmartMast™ hardware into target markets, including initial warehousing and staging ahead of deployment.
  • Vendor Ecosystem Development: Identify, vet, and onboard local installers, fabricators, and port-side vendors capable of supporting SmartMast™ deployment to Quartermaster’s quality and safety standards.

Maritime Stakeholder Engagement

  • Stakeholder Mapping & Outreach: Identify, engage, and convert commercial fleet operators, independent vessel owners, port authorities, and maritime organizations suitable for SmartMast™ deployment.
  • Partnership Structuring: Negotiate and close partnership and space-use agreements (the right to mount and operate our hardware on a vessel) that secure vessel capacity and long-term maritime relationships for Quartermaster.
  • Partner Onboarding: Oversee the transition from signed agreement to operational integration, ensuring new fleet, port, and vendor partners meet Quartermaster’s quality, safety, and performance standards from day one and that Field Operations can deploy without delay.
  • Relationship Management: Build durable, trust-based relationships with fleets, ports, and maritime organizations that build brand trust and reduce bureaucratic friction ahead of deployment.

Regional Leadership

  • Team Building: Recruit, scale, and mentor a local, cross-disciplinary team spanning field operations, market support, and stakeholder relations.
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Align global product, engineering, legal, and marketing teams with the specific requirements of the African market.
  • Market Intelligence: Serve as the primary feedback loop to Quartermaster leadership on regional dynamics, technical requirements, and localized risks.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years in senior operations, market launch, business development, or public policy roles, ideally within maritime, logistics, or other highly regulated sectors.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep understanding of the political, regulatory, and business diversity across Africa’s coastal regions and maritime economies.
  • Diplomatic Edge: Proven track record navigating government relationships, regional maritime bodies, and public-private partnerships across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated success closing complex B2B partnerships, joint ventures, or fleet agreements in emerging or frontier markets.
  • Execution Focus: A bias for action. The ability to draft a market entry plan in the morning and negotiate a stakeholder partnership in the afternoon.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English is required. Professional proficiency in French, Arabic, Portuguese, or Swahili is highly preferred.
